     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/
    43

    56	constraint bit, summed over the bit, is the complement of the reverse
    57	cell-mismatch mass. -/
    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron

   188	          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))

   192	  set QB := (S'.B (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero

   199	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =
   200	      1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k := by

   209	      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
   210	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   289	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
   290	      applyOperatorToState_zero]
   291	  rw [hzero, add_zero]

   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   346	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
   347	  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   348	      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   349	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   350	        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   351	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   352	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
   353	  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   354	    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
   355	  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
   356	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   357	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
   358	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
   359	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   360	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
   361	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   362	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   363	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   365	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   366	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   367	    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
   368	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
   369	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
   370	      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   371	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   372	      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
   373	    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   374	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
   375	    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
   376	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
   377	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   378	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
   379	        norm_sub_le _ _
   380	    _ ≤ _ := by
   381	        rw [h2]
   382	        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
   383	          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

   444	/-- Squaring a three-term estimate. -/
   445	theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :

   447	  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2

   450	/-- Summing the per-outcome estimates over the two outcomes. -/

   455	  have hterm : ∀ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2 :=
   456	    fun b => sq_le_three_mul_of_le (ho b) (h b)
   457	  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
   458	        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
   459	    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by

   461	          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
   462	        push_cast
   463	        ring
   464	    _ ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hL, hm]

   466	/-- Transfer of Alice's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   467	dilated strategy to the original one.  For every target family `I` and target
   468	state `ξ`, the distance of Alice's conjugated original variable bits from `I`
   469	is at most three times the distance of the conjugated dilated bits, plus
   470	`216 ε` from the cell-consistency masses of a strategy of value `1 - ε`, plus
   471	`24 η²` where `η` bounds the distance of the transported dilated state from
   472	`ξ`.  The isometry of the original strategy is the composite of the dilation
   473	embedding and `φ_A`, exactly as in the witness of `exists_ms_rigidity`; the
   474	left-hand side is `msOperatorDistanceA S w j W` for that witness, and the
   475	distance on the right is `msOperatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w' j W`.
   476	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   477	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   478	theorem ms_effect_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   479	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   480	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   481	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   482	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   483	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
   484	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   485	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   486	        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))

   788	/-- Transfer of a product of two conjugated observables on Alice's side: the
   789	product of the conjugated original observables differs from the product of
   790	the conjugated dilated ones, on the target state, by the compressed-product
   791	defect on the dilated state plus twice the state closeness. -/
   792	theorem norm_product_transfer_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   793	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   794	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   795	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)

   797	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   798	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   799	        (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   800	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   801	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   802	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   803	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA A) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry φA B) 1) ξ‖ ≤
   804	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   805	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   806	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B) 1) (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   807	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   808	  have hGc : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   809	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   810	  have hGA := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA) hGc
   811	  have hGB := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hB) hGc
   812	  have hprod : heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   813	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB) *
   814	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   815	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   816	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA A) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry φA B) 1 =
   817	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   818	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   819	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1 := by
   820	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul,
   821	      conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   822	  rw [hprod]
   823	  have hT : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   824	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   825	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) (1 : Op κB)) =
   826	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   827	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   828	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) 1 - heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (A * B)) 1 := by
   829	    rw [conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   830	  have h1 : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   831	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   832	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   833	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   834	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   835	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   836	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   837	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGA hGB))
   838	  have h2 : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (A * B)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   839	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (A * B)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   840	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   841	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hA hB))
   842	  have hswap : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   843	      (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   844	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1) ξ =
   845	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   846	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   847	          (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1)
   848	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)) -
   849	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   850	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   851	          (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1)
   852	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ) := by
   853	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   854	  rw [hswap]
   855	  refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   856	  · rw [applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor]
   857	  · rw [hT]
   858	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le h1 h2 _

   860	/-- The square of a two-term leakage sum is controlled by the cell-mismatch
   861	mass. -/
   862	theorem sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le (ℓ : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (m ε : ℝ)
   863	    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
   864	    (ℓ 0 + ℓ 1) ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε := by
   865	  have h2 : ∑ b : Fin 2, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := hL
   866	  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h2
   867	  have h3 : ℓ 0 ^ 2 + ℓ 1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := h2
   868	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ℓ 0 - ℓ 1)]

   870	/-- The final arithmetic of the anticommutator transfer. -/
   871	theorem anticommutator_arith {o a x z η ε : ℝ} (ho : 0 ≤ o)
   872	    (h : o ≤ a + (x + 2 * z + 2 * η) + (z + 2 * x + 2 * η))
   873	    (hx : x ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) (hz : z ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) :
   874	    o ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a ^ 2 + 15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   875	  have h1 : o ^ 2 ≤ (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 :=
   876	    pow_le_pow_left₀ ho (by linarith) 2
   877	  have h2 : (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 ≤
   878	      3 * a ^ 2 + 3 * (3 * (x + z)) ^ 2 + 3 * (4 * η) ^ 2 := by
   879	    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 3 * (x + z)), sq_nonneg (3 * (x + z) - 4 * η),
   880	      sq_nonneg (a - 4 * η)]
   881	  have h3 : (x + z) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * z ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - z)]
   882	  nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, hx, hz]

   884	/-- Transfer of Alice's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   885	dilated strategy to the original one.  The left-hand side is
   886	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA S w` for the witness whose isometry is the composite
   887	of the dilation embedding and `φ_A`, and the distance on the right is
   888	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w'`.  The transfer costs the
   889	leakage of both dilated observables out of the ground slice, controlled by the
   890	cell-consistency masses, and the state closeness.  Blueprint
   891	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   892	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   893	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   894	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   895	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   896	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   897	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   898	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   899	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   900	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   901	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   902	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   903	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   904	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   905	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   906	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   907	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   908	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ ≤
   909	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   910	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   911	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   912	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   913	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   914	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   915	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   916	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   917	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ +
   918	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   919	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   920	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   921	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   922	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   923	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_A, naimarkInflation_obs_A]

   926	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   927	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -

   929	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   930	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   931	        dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   932	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1 *
   933	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 -
   934	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 *
   935	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   936	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   937	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 0)
   938	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 4)
   939	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   940	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   941	  -- leakage and intertwining of the two observables
   942	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i0 k0

   945	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i4 k4

   950	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   951	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ

   955	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))

   967	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd

   974	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   975	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

     4	/-!
     5	# Magic Square value-to-parity relations
     6	
     7	This file extracts the elementary probability relations used at the start of
     8	the Magic Square rigidity argument.  A strategy of value at least `1 - ε` has
     9	total rejection mass at most `ε`.  Since the question distribution is
    10	supported on at most 36 directed incidences, the rejection mass at each
    11	incidence is at most `36 * ε`.  This controls malformed answers, consistency
    12	of the two reported bits at every cell, and the parity product on each of the
    13	six row or column constraints.
    14	
    15	The arguments apply to arbitrary finite POVMs.  In particular, malformed
    16	answers remain in the event masses when `msBitOrZero` and
    17	`constraintBitOrZero` turn the common answer alphabet into binary outcomes.
    18	
    19	## References
    20	
    21	The Magic Square game is defined in
    22	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:512-610`
    23	and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:201-222`.  These relations are the
    24	probabilistic input to the rigidity result cited at paper lines 612-652 from
    25	Coladangelo--Stark, Theorem 6.9.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    29	
    30	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity
    31	
    32	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum

    36	/-! ## The directed incidence distribution -/
    37	
    38	/-- The 36 possible directed constraint-variable incidences. -/
    39	def directedIncidence : ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool) → MsType × MsType
    40	  | ((i, k), false) => (.constraint i, .var (msConstraintVars i k))
    41	  | ((i, k), true) => (.var (msConstraintVars i k), .constraint i)
    42	
    43	/-- Every question pair in the Magic Square distribution is a directed incidence. -/
    44	theorem ms_support_subset_directed_incidences :
    45	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support ⊆
    46	      (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image directedIncidence := by
    47	  intro xy hxy
    48	  have hedge : Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ msEdges :=
    49	    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxy).2
    50	  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hedge with ⟨ik, _hik, heq⟩
    51	  have heq' :
    52	      ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) = xy ∨
    53	        ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) =
    54	          xy.swap :=
    55	    (Sym2.mk_eq_mk_iff (α := MsType)).mp heq
    56	  rcases heq' with heq' | heq'
    57	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, false), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    58	    simpa [directedIncidence] using heq'
    59	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, true), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    60	    simpa [directedIncidence] using congrArg Prod.swap heq'
    61	
    62	/-- The Magic Square question distribution has at most 36 support points. -/
    63	theorem ms_support_card_le :
    64	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤ 36 := by
    65	  calc
    66	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤
    67	        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image
    68	          directedIncidence).card :=
    69	      Finset.card_le_card ms_support_subset_directed_incidences
    70	    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).card :=
    71	      Finset.card_image_le
    72	    _ = 36 := by norm_num

    77	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    78	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr

    85	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    86	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    87	  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩

    91	/-- Every supported question pair has probability at least `1 / 36`. -/
    92	theorem ms_question_weight_ge {xy : MsType × MsType}
    93	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
    94	    (1 : ℝ) / 36 ≤ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy := by
    95	  have hmemFilter :
    96	      xy ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
    97	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges) := hxy
    98	  rw [show (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy =
    99	      1 / ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card : ℝ) by
   100	    change (Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   101	        ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   102	          Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges)).weight xy =
   103	      1 / (((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   104	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges).card : ℝ)
   105	    rw [Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight, if_pos hmemFilter]]
   106	  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
   107	  · exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨xy, hxy⟩
   108	  · exact_mod_cast ms_support_card_le

   112	/-- The rejection mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   113	noncomputable def rejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   114	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   115	
   116	/-- The acceptance mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   117	noncomputable def acceptanceMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   118	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = true
   119	
   120	/-- The rejection mass averaged over the Magic Square question distribution. -/
   121	noncomputable def totalRejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) : ℝ :=
   122	  avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   123	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2
   124	
   125	/-- Acceptance and rejection partition the conditioned answer mass. -/
   126	theorem acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   127	    acceptanceMass S x y + rejectionMass S x y = 1 := by
   128	  rw [← show (∑ a : MsAnswer, ∑ b : MsAnswer, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = 1 by
   129	    exact outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S x y]
   130	  unfold acceptanceMass rejectionMass outcomeEventWeight
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   132	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   133	  intro a _
   134	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   135	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   136	  intro b _
   137	  cases h : msWinPredicate x y a b <;> simp [h]
   138	
   139	/-- The strategy value is the average conditioned acceptance mass. -/
   140	theorem strategy_value_eq_acceptance_mass (S : Strategy msGame) :
   141	    S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   142	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 := by
   143	  rfl
   144	
   145	/-- Total rejection mass is exactly one minus the strategy value. -/
   146	theorem total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value (S : Strategy msGame) :
   147	    totalRejectionMass S = 1 - S.value := by
   148	  rw [show S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   149	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) by rfl]
   150	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   151	  calc
   152	    avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   153	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2) =
   154	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   155	          1 - acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   156	      apply avgOver_congr
   157	      intro xy
   158	      linarith [show acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 + rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 = 1 by
   159	        exact acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass S xy.1 xy.2]
   160	    _ = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun _ => 1) -
   161	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   162	          acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := avgOver_sub _ _ _
   163	    _ = 1 - avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   164	        acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   165	      rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (by
   166	        unfold graphDistribution
   167	        apply Distribution.uniformOnFinset_isProbability
   168	        refine ⟨(.constraint 0, .var (msConstraintVars 0 0)), ?_⟩
   169	        simp [msEdges])]
   170	
   171	/-- Total rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   172	theorem total_rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) :
   173	    0 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   174	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   175	  exact avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun xy => outcome_event_weight_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2 _
   176	
   177	/-- Value at least `1 - ε` implies total rejection mass at most `ε`. -/
   178	theorem total_rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   179	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) : totalRejectionMass S ≤ ε := by
   180	  rw [total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value]
   181	  linarith
   182	
   183	/-- Conditioned rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   184	theorem rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   185	    0 ≤ rejectionMass S x y :=
   186	  outcome_event_weight_nonneg S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   187	
   188	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most 36 times total rejection. -/
   189	theorem rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total (S : Strategy msGame)
   190	    {xy : MsType × MsType}
   191	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   192	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S := by
   193	  have hrejection : 0 ≤ rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   194	    rejection_mass_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2
   195	  have hweight := ms_question_weight_ge hxy
   196	  have hterm :
   197	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   198	          rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   199	    unfold totalRejectionMass avgOver
   200	    exact Finset.single_le_sum
   201	      (fun z _ => mul_nonneg
   202	        ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).nonnegative z)
   203	        (rejection_mass_nonneg S z.1 z.2)) hxy
   204	  have hscaled : (1 / 36 : ℝ) * rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤
   205	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   206	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   207	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight hrejection
   208	  nlinarith
   209	
   210	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   211	theorem rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   212	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) {xy : MsType × MsType}
   213	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   214	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * ε := by
   215	  calc
   216	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S :=
   217	      rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total S hxy
   218	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   219	      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (total_rejection_mass_le S ε hwin) (by norm_num)
   220	
   221	/-- An event which always rejects has mass at most the conditioned rejection mass. -/
   222	theorem outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType)
   223	    (E : MsAnswer → MsAnswer → Prop) [DecidableRel E]
   224	    (hE : ∀ a b, E a b → msWinPredicate x y a b = false) :
   225	    outcomeEventWeight S x y E ≤ rejectionMass S x y := by
   226	  exact outcome_event_weight_mono S x y E _ hE

   230	/-- The selected constraint bit, with a wrong-form single-bit answer folded to zero. -/
   231	def constraintBitOrZero (k : Fin 3) : MsAnswer → ZMod 2
   232	  | .triple β => β k
   233	  | .bit _ => 0

   237	  | .triple _ => true
   238	  | .bit _ => false

   242	  | .triple _ => false
   243	  | .bit _ => true

   245	/-- The three cells in any fixed row or column are distinct. -/
   246	theorem constraint_vars_injective (i : Fin 6) : Function.Injective (msConstraintVars i) := by
   247	  intro k l hkl
   248	  apply Fin.ext
   249	  unfold msConstraintVars at hkl
   250	  split at hkl <;> simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at hkl ⊢ <;> omega
   251	
   252	/-- Every Magic Square variable is incident to a row constraint. -/
   253	theorem every_variable_is_incident (j : Fin 9) :
   254	    ∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j := by
   255	  let i : Fin 6 := ⟨j.val / 3, by omega⟩
   256	  let k : Fin 3 := ⟨j.val % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
   257	  refine ⟨i, k, ?_⟩
   258	  apply Fin.ext
   259	  simp only [msConstraintVars, i, k]
   260	  rw [if_pos (by omega)]
   261	  omega

   299	/-- Alice's wrong-form mass at every variable question is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   300	theorem alice_variable_wrong_form_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   301	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9) :
   302	    aliceVariableWrongFormMass S j ≤ 36 * ε := by
   303	  rcases every_variable_is_incident j with ⟨i, k, hj⟩

   305	  unfold aliceVariableWrongFormMass
   306	  rw [← outcome_event_weight_left_eq S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)]
   307	  calc
   308	    outcomeEventWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
   309	        (fun a _ => wrongVariableAnswer a = true) ≤
   310	        rejectionMass S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) :=
   311	      outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass S _ _ _ (reverse_wrong_variable_rejects i k)
   312	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   313	      rejection_mass_le S ε hwin (ms_reverse_incidence_mem_support i k)

   360	noncomputable def forwardCellMismatchMass (S : Strategy msGame)

   367	    (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) : ℝ :=

   372	    (a b : MsAnswer) (hmismatch : constraintBitOrZero k a ≠ msBitOrZero b) :

   379	      | bit γ =>

   384	          have hlk : l = k := constraint_vars_injective i hl
   385	          subst l
   386	          exact hmismatch hbit

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/

    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)

   152	theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :

   814	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   815	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   816	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA A) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry φA B) 1 =
   817	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   818	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   819	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1 := by
   820	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul,

   843	      (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *

   860	/-- The square of a two-term leakage sum is controlled by the cell-mismatch

   881	  have h3 : (x + z) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * z ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - z)]

   898	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   899	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :

   903	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   904	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   905	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))

   910	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA

   912	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   913	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   914	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   915	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   916	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   917	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ +
   918	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   919	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   920	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   921	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ

   931	        dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤

   934	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 *
   935	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   936	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   937	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 0)
   938	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 4)
   939	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   940	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)

   951	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ

   953	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))

   955	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))

   967	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd

   134	/-- The one-measurement preservation identity identifies the `⊥,⊥`

   136	theorem OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none
   137	    {Outcome : Type u} [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   138	    {d : Type u} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   139	    (data : OneMeasNaimarkData Outcome d) (a : Outcome) (i j : d) :

   141	      data.source.effect a i j := by

   324	noncomputable def naimarkDilatedMeasurement {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   325	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ : α) :
   326	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (d × Option α) :=
   327	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀)

   333	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   334	    (naimarkDilatedMeasurement M a₀).effect a = naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a := rfl

   337	argument of `thm:ms-rigidity` uses. -/

   343	/-- The compression of a dilated effect to the ground slice is the original
   344	effect.  This is the defining property of a Naimark dilation, and the reason the
   345	dilated strategy reproduces every Born probability of the original one. -/
   346	theorem naimarkCompression_naimarkDilatedEffect {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   347	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   348	    naimarkCompression (naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a) = M.effect a := by
   349	  have hlift : ∀ b : α,
   350	      naimarkCompression ((naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some b)) = M.effect b := by
   351	    intro b
   352	    ext i j
   353	    have h := (naimarkData M).compression_none_none b i j
   354	    rw [naimarkData_source M] at h
   355	    simpa using h
   356	  have hdef : naimarkCompression
   357	      (1 - ∑ b : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some b)) = 0 := by
   358	    rw [naimarkCompression_sub, naimarkCompression_one, naimarkCompression_sum]
   359	    simp only [hlift]
   360	    rw [M.sum_eq_one, sub_self]
   361	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   362	  rw [naimarkCompression_add, hlift]
   363	  by_cases h : a = a₀
   364	  · simp [h, hdef]
   365	  · simp [h]

   367	/-! ## The dilated state -/
   368	
   369	/-- The image of a bipartite state under the two ground embeddings.  This is the
   370	state of the dilated strategy supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   371	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   372	noncomputable def naimarkDilatedState (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   373	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   374	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   375	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   376	  isometryTensor (naimarkEmbedding ιA α) (naimarkEmbedding ιB α) ψ
   377	
   378	/-- The coordinates of the dilated state: the original amplitudes sit on the
   379	ground slice, where both auxiliary registers carry the adjoined basis vector,
   380	and all remaining coordinates vanish. -/
   381	theorem naimarkDilatedState_apply (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   382	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   383	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (p : (ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :
   384	    naimarkDilatedState α ψ p =
   385	      if p.1.2 = none ∧ p.2.2 = none then ψ (p.1.1, p.2.1) else 0 := by
   386	  classical
   387	  obtain ⟨⟨i, oa⟩, ⟨j, ob⟩⟩ := p
   388	  simp only [naimarkDilatedState, isometryTensor]
   389	  by_cases hoa : oa = none
   390	  · by_cases hob : ob = none
   391	    · simp [hoa, hob, EuclideanSpace.equiv, eq_comm]
   392	    · simp [hob]
   393	  · simp [hoa]
   394	
   395	/-- The quadratic form of an operator on a pure state, written out in the
   396	computational basis.  Formalization-only support for the dilation of
   397	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   398	theorem inner_applyOperatorToState {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   399	    (K : Op ι) (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   400	    inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState K u) =
   401	      ∑ p : ι, ∑ q : ι, (starRingEnd ℂ) (u p) * (K p q * u q) := by
   402	  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, applyOperatorToState,
   403	    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
   404	
   405	/-- On the ground slice the dilated state factors as the original amplitude
   406	times the two indicator amplitudes of the auxiliary registers. -/
   407	theorem naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   408	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   409	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (i : ιA) (oa : Option α) (j : ιB) (ob : Option α) :
   410	    naimarkDilatedState α ψ ((i, oa), (j, ob)) =
   411	      (if oa = none then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
   412	        ((if ob = none then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * ψ (i, j)) := by
   413	  rw [naimarkDilatedState_apply]
   414	  by_cases h1 : oa = none <;> by_cases h2 : ob = none <;> simp [h1, h2]
   415	
   416	/-- The quadratic form of a product operator on the dilated state agrees with the
   417	quadratic form of the two ground-slice compressions on the original state.  This
   418	is the identity that makes the dilation invisible to every observable quantity of
   419	the strategy. -/
   420	theorem inner_heteroKron_naimarkDilatedState (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   421	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   422	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   423	    (M : Op (ιA × Option α)) (N : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   424	    inner ℂ (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)
   425	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron M N) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)) =
   426	      inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState
   427	        (heteroKron (naimarkCompression M) (naimarkCompression N)) ψ) := by
   428	  classical
   429	  rw [inner_applyOperatorToState, inner_applyOperatorToState]
   430	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul,
   431	    heteroKron, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, mul_comm, mul_assoc]
   432	
   433	/-- The ground embeddings are isometric, so the dilated state is again a unit
   434	vector when the original one is. -/
   435	theorem naimarkDilatedState_norm (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   436	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   437	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   438	    ‖naimarkDilatedState α ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   439	  classical
   440	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
   441	  congr 1
   442	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul]

   621	/-- The matrix of a linear isometry of Euclidean spaces in the computational
   622	bases.  Formalization-only support for `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   623	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   624	noncomputable def isometryMatrix {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   625	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   626	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') : Matrix ι' ι ℂ :=
   627	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
   628	
   629	/-- Conjugation by an isometry is conjugation by its matrix. -/
   630	theorem conjIsometry_eq {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   631	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   632	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (M : Op ι) :
   633	    conjIsometry φ M = isometryMatrix φ * M * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := rfl
   634	
   635	/-- The matrix of an isometry acts on vectors as the isometry does. -/
   636	theorem isometryMatrix_mulVec {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   637	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   638	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   639	    isometryMatrix φ *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x = WithLp.ofLp (φ x) := by
   640	  have h : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   641	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   642	  have h' : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) x = φ x := by rw [h]; rfl
   643	  simpa using congrArg WithLp.ofLp h'
   644	
   645	/-- The columns of the matrix of an isometry are the images of the basis
   646	vectors. -/
   647	theorem isometryMatrix_apply {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   648	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   649	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (k : ι') (i : ι) :
   650	    isometryMatrix φ k i =
   651	      φ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1)) k := by
   652	  have h := congrFun (isometryMatrix_mulVec φ
   653	    ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) k
   654	  rw [← h]
   655	  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.equiv, eq_comm]
   656	
   657	/-- The matrix of a composite isometry is the product of the two matrices. -/
   658	theorem isometryMatrix_comp {ι κ ν : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   659	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν]
   660	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ν)
   661	    (E : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
   662	    isometryMatrix (φ.comp E) = isometryMatrix φ * isometryMatrix E := by
   663	  ext k i
   664	  have h := congrFun (isometryMatrix_mulVec φ
   665	    (E ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1)))) k
   666	  rw [isometryMatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
   667	  simp only [isometryMatrix_apply E]
   668	  simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h.symm

   673	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/

   676	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ν)
   677	    (E : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) (M : Op ι) :
   678	    conjIsometry (φ.comp E) M = conjIsometry φ (conjIsometry E M) := by
   679	  rw [conjIsometry_eq, conjIsometry_eq, conjIsometry_eq, isometryMatrix_comp]

   682	/-- The two-sided isometry image of a bipartite state, written through the
   683	Kronecker product of the two isometry matrices. -/
   684	theorem isometryTensor_apply_eq {ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
   685	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   686	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   687	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   688	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   689	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (p : κA × κB) :
   690	    isometryTensor φA φB ψ p =
   691	      ∑ q : ιA × ιB,
   692	        Matrix.kronecker (isometryMatrix φA) (isometryMatrix φB) p q * ψ q := by
   693	  simp [isometryTensor, Matrix.kronecker, Fintype.sum_prod_type, isometryMatrix_apply,
   694	    EuclideanSpace.equiv, mul_assoc]
   695	
   696	/-- Applying two local isometries after two others is the same as applying their
   697	composites.  Together with `conjIsometry_comp` this is the composition rule used
   698	to turn a rigidity witness for the dilated strategy into one for the original
   699	strategy. -/
   700	theorem isometryTensor_comp {ιA ιB κA κB νA νB : Type}
   701	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   702	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
   703	    [Fintype νA] [DecidableEq νA] [Fintype νB] [DecidableEq νB]
   704	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ κA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ νA)
   705	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ κB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ νB)
   706	    (EA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   707	    (EB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   708	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   709	    isometryTensor (φA.comp EA) (φB.comp EB) ψ =
   710	      isometryTensor φA φB (isometryTensor EA EB ψ) := by
   711	  ext p
   712	  rw [isometryTensor_apply_eq, isometryTensor_apply_eq]
   713	  simp only [isometryTensor_apply_eq, isometryMatrix_comp, Finset.mul_sum]
   714	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   715	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
   716	  have hk : (isometryMatrix φA * isometryMatrix EA).kronecker
   717	        (isometryMatrix φB * isometryMatrix EB) =
   718	      (isometryMatrix φA).kronecker (isometryMatrix φB) *
   719	        (isometryMatrix EA).kronecker (isometryMatrix EB) :=
   720	    Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul _ _ _ _
   721	  rw [hk, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
   722	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by ring

   732	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   795	theorem applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation

   808	  · by_cases hob : ob = none
   809	    · simp [hoa, hob, heteroKron, applyOperatorToState, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,

   811	    · simp [hob, heteroKron]

   818	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

   826	/-- Every average squared distance between two families of *inflated*
   827	operators, measured on the dilated state, is the corresponding distance between
   828	the original families measured on the original state.  This identity concerns
   829	inflations only: the dilated projectors of `msDilatedStrategy` are not
   830	inflations, and their difference from the inflated original effects on the
   831	dilated state is the leakage out of the ground slice, which is controlled in
   832	`Rigidity/Transfer.lean` (`ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`,
   833	`ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`) by the
   834	cell-consistency masses of the value-to-parity layer.  Blueprint
   835	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   836	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   837	theorem opFamilyDistSq_naimarkInflation (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   838	    {X γ ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype γ] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
   839	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   840	    (μ : Distribution X) (M N : X → γ → Op ιA) (P : X → γ → Op ιB)
   841	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   842	    opFamilyDistSq μ
   843	        (fun x c => heteroKron (naimarkInflation (α := α) (M x c))
   844	          (naimarkInflation (α := α) (P x c)))
   845	        (fun x c => heteroKron (naimarkInflation (α := α) (N x c))
   846	          (naimarkInflation (α := α) (P x c)))
   847	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   848	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x c => heteroKron (M x c) (P x c))
   849	        (fun x c => heteroKron (N x c) (P x c)) ψ := by
   850	  unfold opFamilyDistSq
   851	  congr 1
   852	  funext x
   853	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_

   857	    intro ρA ρB _ _ _ _ X Y Z

   859	    simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, sub_mul]

   862	    ext p q
   863	    by_cases h : p.2 = none ∧ q.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   864	  rw [hkron, hkron, hinfl, norm_applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation]

431	/-! ## The ground projection -/
   432	
   433	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   434	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   435	transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   436	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   437	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   438	  naimarkInflation (α := α) (1 : Op ι)

   440	/-- Inflation is multiplicative. -/
   441	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   442	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   443	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   444	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   445	  ext p q
   446	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   447	    Fintype.sum_option]
   448	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   449	
   450	/-- Inflation commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   451	theorem naimarkInflation_conjTranspose {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   452	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   453	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by
   454	  ext p q
   455	  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, naimarkInflation_apply]
   456	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]

   458	/-- The ground projection is an orthogonal projection. -/
   459	theorem isProj_groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   460	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : IsProj (groundProjection ι α) := by
   461	  constructor
   462	  · change groundProjection ι α * groundProjection ι α = groundProjection ι α
   463	    rw [groundProjection, naimarkInflation_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   464	  · change star (groundProjection ι α) = groundProjection ι α
   465	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, groundProjection, naimarkInflation_conjTranspose,

   539	side. -/
   540	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   541	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   542	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   546	      1 - heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α) := by

   548	  have hsub : applyOperatorToState (1 - heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α))
   549	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   550	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   551	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α))
   552	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by

   554	  rw [h, hsub, applyOperatorToState_one, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection,

   557	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   558	
   559	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   560	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   561	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   562	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   563	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/

   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/

    69	theorem questionwiseNaimark {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type*}
    70	    {ι : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
    72	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
    73	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
    74	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
    75	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    76	    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    77	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA ι)
    78	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB ι) :
    79	    ∃ data : NaimarkData QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB ι,
    80	      NaimarkStatement ψ A B data := by
    81	  classical
    82	  let leftData : (x : QuestionA) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA ι :=
    83	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData A
    84	  let rightData : (y : QuestionB) → OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB ι :=
    85	    questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData B
    86	  have hleft : ∀ x : QuestionA, (leftData x).source.effect = (A x).outcome := by
    87	    intro x
    88	    simpa [leftData] using questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData_source_effect A x
    89	  have hright : ∀ y : QuestionB, (rightData y).source.effect = (B y).outcome := by

    91	    simpa [rightData] using questionwiseOneMeasNaimarkData_source_effect B y
    92	  refine ⟨{ left := leftData, right := rightData }, ?_⟩
    93	  refine ⟨hleft, hright, ?_, ?_⟩
    94	  · intro x ρ a
    95	    simpa [leftData, hleft x] using (leftData x).expectation_preservation ρ a
    96	  · intro y ρ b
    97	    simpa [rightData, hright y] using (rightData y).expectation_preservation ρ b

   101	/-- The single auxiliary Hilbert space used by the full Naimark assembly on one side.
   102	
   103	The one-measurement theorem produces projectors on `H × Option Outcome`.  Since
   104	all questions on one side have the same outcome type, the different question
   105	measurements may be represented on the same auxiliary space, with a different
   106	Naimark unitary for each question. -/
   107	def oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace (Outcome : Type u)
   108	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   109	    FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} where
   110	  carrier := Option Outcome
   111	  instFintype := inferInstance
   112	  instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   113	  instNonempty := ⟨none⟩
   114	
   115	/-- The distinguished auxiliary basis state `|⊥⟩` for the one-register Naimark
   116	assembly. -/
   117	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxPureState (Outcome : Type u)
   118	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   119	    PureState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   120	  PureState.basis (none : Option Outcome)
   121	
   122	/-- The normalized auxiliary density state `|⊥⟩⟨⊥|`. -/
   123	noncomputable def oneNaimarkAuxState (Outcome : Type u)
   124	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   125	    QuantumState (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace Outcome).carrier :=
   126	  oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome

   129	theorem oneNaimarkAuxState_isNormalized (Outcome : Type u)
   130	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   131	    (oneNaimarkAuxState Outcome).IsNormalized := by
   132	  exact PureState.toQuantumState_isNormalized (oneNaimarkAuxPureState Outcome)

   180	/-- The two-sided trace identity for the full tensor-product Naimark assembly.
   181	
   182	Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:161-187`, where the
   183	one-measurement helper is applied on Alice's and Bob's sides and then tensored

   189	    {OutcomeA OutcomeB : Type u}
   190	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
   191	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
   192	    (HA HB : FiniteHilbertSpace.{u})
   193	    (ψ : QuantumState (HA.carrier × HB.carrier))
   194	    (leftData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeA HA.carrier)
   195	    (rightData : OneMeasNaimarkData OutcomeB HB.carrier)
   196	    (a : OutcomeA) (b : OutcomeB) :
   197	    ev ψ (opTensor (leftData.source.effect a) (rightData.source.effect b)) =
   198	      ev
   199	        (naimarkProductExtensionState HA HB
   200	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA)
   201	          (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB)
   202	          ψ
   203	          (QuantumState.tensor
   204	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeA)
   205	            (oneNaimarkAuxState OutcomeB)))
   206	        (opTensor
   207	          ((leftData.toProjSubMeas).outcome a)
   208	          ((rightData.toProjSubMeas).outcome b)) := by
   209	  classical
   210	  have hleft_comp :
   211	      ∀ i j : HA.carrier,
   212	        leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (i, none) (j, none) =
   213	          leftData.source.effect a i j :=
   214	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none leftData a
   215	  have hright_comp :
   216	      ∀ i j : HB.carrier,
   217	        rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (i, none) (j, none) =
   218	          rightData.source.effect b i j :=
   219	    OneMeasNaimarkData.compression_none_none rightData b
   220	  unfold ev
   221	  congr 1
   222	  unfold MIPStarRE.Quantum.normalizedTrace
   223	  simp [naimarkProductExtensionState, naimarkProductExtensionDensity,
   224	    QuantumState.tensor, oneNaimarkAuxState, oneNaimarkAuxPureState,
   225	    PureState.density, pureDensity, PureState.basis, Matrix.mul_apply,
   226	    Matrix.trace, opTensor, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.vecMulVec]
   227	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, OneMeasNaimarkData.toProjSubMeas,
   228	    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
   229	  field_simp
   230	  let cA : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeA).carrier
   231	  let cB : ℂ := Fintype.card (oneNaimarkAuxHilbertSpace OutcomeB).carrier
   232	  let S : ℂ :=
   233	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   234	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   235	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   236	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   237	            ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   238	              leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   239	              rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1
   240	  change S * cA * cB =
   241	    ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   242	      ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   243	        ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   244	          ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   245	            cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   246	              leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   247	              rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)
   248	  rw [show
   249	      (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   250	        ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   251	          ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   252	            ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   253	              cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   254	                leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   255	                rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none)) =
   256	        cA * cB * S by
   257	      calc
   258	        (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   259	          ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   260	            ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   261	              ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   262	                cA * cB * ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   263	                  leftData.liftedEffect (some a) (x_2, none) (x, none) *
   264	                  rightData.liftedEffect (some b) (x_3, none) (x_1, none))
   265	            = ∑ x : HA.carrier,
   266	              ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   267	                ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,
   268	                  ∑ x_3 : HB.carrier,
   269	                    cA * cB *
   270	                      (ψ.density (x, x_1) (x_2, x_3) *
   271	                        leftData.source.effect a x_2 x *
   272	                        rightData.source.effect b x_3 x_1) := by
   273	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   274	              intro x _
   275	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   276	              intro x_1 _
   277	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   278	              intro x_2 _
   279	              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   280	              intro x_3 _
   281	              rw [hleft_comp x_2 x, hright_comp x_3 x_1]
   282	              ring
   283	        _ = cA * cB * S := by
   284	              simp [S, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]]

    18	/-- The Naimark column acts as an isometry on the input subspace: `VP = V`. -/
    19	private lemma oneMeasNaimarkColumn_mul_inputProj
    20	    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    21	    {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    22	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement α d) :
    23	    oneMeasNaimarkColumn M * oneMeasNaimarkInputProj (α := α) (d := d) =
    24	      oneMeasNaimarkColumn M := by
    25	  ext ⟨d₁, oa₁⟩ ⟨d₂, oa₂⟩
    26	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, oneMeasNaimarkInputProj,
    27	    oneMeasNaimarkAuxTransition]
    28	  cases oa₂ with
    29	  | none =>
    30	    have : ∀ x : d × Option α,
    31	        oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) x *
    32	          Matrix.kronecker (1 : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op d)
    33	            (Matrix.single (none : Option α) (none : Option α) (1 : ℂ)) x (d₂, none) =
    34	          if x = (d₂, (none : Option α)) then
    35	            oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) (d₂, none)
    36	          else 0 := by
    37	      intro ⟨k₁, k₂⟩
    38	      cases k₂ with
    39	      | none =>
    40	          by_cases h : k₁ = d₂ <;>
    41	            simp [Matrix.kronecker, Prod.ext_iff, h]
    42	      | some a =>
    43	          have hneq : (k₁, some a) ≠ (d₂, (none : Option α)) := by
    44	            intro h
    45	            cases h
    46	          simp [Matrix.kronecker, hneq]
    47	    simp_rw [this]
    48	    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (d₂, (none : Option α)) (fun _ =>
    49	      oneMeasNaimarkColumn M (d₁, oa₁) (d₂, none))]
    50	    simp
    51	  | some a₂ =>
    52	    simp [oneMeasNaimarkColumn, Matrix.kronecker]

    54	-- This is independent of Naimark and could be moved to `LDT/Preliminaries`.
    55	/-- **Partial isometry to unitary extension** (general fact).
    56	
    57	If `V†V = P` where `P` is a projection and `V = VP`, then there exists
    58	a unitary `U` on the full space with `UP = V`.
    59	
    60	This is a standard result in finite-dimensional linear algebra: V is an
    61	isometry from range(P) to V's range, and in finite dimensions any
    62	isometry between subspaces extends to a unitary.
    63	
    64	**Mathlib route**: `LinearIsometry.extend` provides the extension for
    65	linear isometries between inner product spaces. The gap is the
    66	matrix-to-`EuclideanSpace` transport. -/
    67	private lemma partialIsometry_to_unitary
    68	    {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    69	    (V P : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n)
    70	    (hP : MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj P)
    71	    (hVP : V * P = V)
    72	    (hVV : Vᴴ * V = P) :
    73	    ∃ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ,
    74	      (U : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n) * P = V := by
    75	  classical
    76	  have toEuclideanLin_mul :
    77	      ∀ A B : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op n,
    78	        Matrix.toEuclideanLin (A * B) =
    79	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).comp (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B) := by
    80	    intro A B
    81	    simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same (p := (2 : ENNReal)) A B]
    82	  let Pₗ : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := Matrix.toEuclideanLin P
    83	  let Vₗ : EuclideanSpace ℂ n →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ n := Matrix.toEuclideanLin V
    84	  let S : Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ n) := LinearMap.range Pₗ
    85	  letI : InnerProductSpace ℂ S := Submodule.innerProductSpace S
    86	  have hP_fix : ∀ x : S, Pₗ (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) = x := by
    87	    intro x
    88	    rcases x.2 with ⟨y, hy⟩
    89	    rw [← hy]
    90	    calc
    91	      Pₗ (Pₗ y) = (Pₗ.comp Pₗ) y := rfl
    92	      _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (P * P) y := by rw [toEuclideanLin_mul]
    93	      _ = Pₗ y := by rw [hP.isIdempotentElem.eq]
    94	  have hVP_lin : Vₗ.comp Pₗ = Vₗ := by
    95	    calc
    96	      Vₗ.comp Pₗ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (V * P) := by rw [toEuclideanLin_mul]
    97	      _ = Vₗ := by rw [hVP]
