 def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=
   Matrix.kronecker A B
 
+/-! ### Algebra of the tensor placement
+
+The shared tensor-placement API.  These identities are used both by the perfect
+Magic Square strategy (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint
+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:257-267`) and by the rigidity transfer
+step (`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`), so they live
+with the definition rather than in either development. -/
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`, paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`): the tensor
+placement is multiplicative, `(A ⊗ C) * (B ⊗ D) = (A * B) ⊗ (C * D)`. -/
+theorem heteroKron_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
+    (A B : Op ιA) (C D : Op ιB) :
+    heteroKron A C * heteroKron B D = heteroKron (A * B) (C * D) := by
+  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
+  exact (Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul A B C D).symm
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): the tensor
+placement of the two identity operators is the identity operator on the product
+space. -/
+theorem heteroKron_one_one {ιA ιB : Type*} [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] :
+    heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (1 : Op ιB) = 1 := by
+  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
+  exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
+respects negation in the left factor. -/
+theorem heteroKron_neg_left {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
+    heteroKron (-A) C = -heteroKron A C := by
+  ext p q
+  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
+respects negation in the right factor. -/
+theorem heteroKron_neg_right {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
+    heteroKron A (-C) = -heteroKron A C := by
+  ext p q
+  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
+
 /- The Euclidean linear map is the shared action used by the value and distance
 functionals.  Keeping it at the Euclidean-space level avoids accidentally
 using the function-space supremum norm of `Matrix.mulVec`. -/

   279	/-- The matrix of an isometry is a matrix isometry. -/
   280	theorem isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   281	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   282	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   283	    (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ = 1 := by
   284	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   285	  have hM : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   286	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   287	  calc
   288	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ) =
   289	        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)).adjoint.comp
   290	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)) :=
   291	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self _
   292	    _ = φ.toLinearMap.adjoint.comp φ.toLinearMap := by rw [hM]
   293	    _ = 1 := φ.adjoint_comp_self'
   294	    _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
   295	      rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]
   296	      rfl

   298	/-- The range projection `V Vᴴ` of a matrix isometry is at most the identity. -/
   299	theorem isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   300	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   301	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   302	    isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤ 1 := by
   303	  have hproj : IsProj (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) := by
   304	    constructor
   305	    · change (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) *
   306	        (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   307	      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ,
   308	        isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   309	    · change star (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   310	        isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   311	      simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   312	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hproj.one_sub.nonneg

   314	/-- Conjugation by an isometry preserves contractions. -/
   315	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   316	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   317	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') {A : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) :
   318	    (conjIsometry φ A)ᴴ * conjIsometry φ A ≤ 1 := by
   319	  rw [conjIsometry_eq]
   320	  have h1 : (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ)ᴴ *
   321	      (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   322	      isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   323	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
   324	      Matrix.mul_assoc]
   325	    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ (isometryMatrix φ),
   326	      isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   327	  rw [h1]
   328	  calc isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤
   329	        isometryMatrix φ * (1 : Op ι) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   330	        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
   331	        have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (isometryMatrix φ)
   332	        convert h using 1
   333	        simp [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
   334	    _ = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
   335	    _ ≤ 1 := isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one φ

   369	theorem kronecker_isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul {ιA ιB κA κB : Type}

   395	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry {ιA ιB κA κB : Type}

   431	/-! ## The ground projection -/
   432	
   433	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   434	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   435	transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   436	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   437	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   438	  naimarkInflation (α := α) (1 : Op ι)
   439	
   440	/-- Inflation is multiplicative. -/
   441	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   442	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   443	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   444	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   445	  ext p q
   446	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   447	    Fintype.sum_option]
   448	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   449	
   450	/-- Inflation commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   451	theorem naimarkInflation_conjTranspose {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   452	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   453	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by
   454	  ext p q
   455	  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, naimarkInflation_apply]
   456	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   457	
   458	/-- The ground projection is an orthogonal projection. -/
   459	theorem isProj_groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   460	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : IsProj (groundProjection ι α) := by
   461	  constructor
   462	  · change groundProjection ι α * groundProjection ι α = groundProjection ι α
   463	    rw [groundProjection, naimarkInflation_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   464	  · change star (groundProjection ι α) = groundProjection ι α
   465	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, groundProjection, naimarkInflation_conjTranspose,
   466	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one]

   468	/-- Inflating the compression of an operator to the ground slice is compressing
   469	it by the ground projection. -/
   470	theorem naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   471	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (P : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   472	    naimarkInflation (α := α) (naimarkCompression (α := α) P) =
   473	      groundProjection ι α * P * groundProjection ι α := by
   474	  ext p q
   475	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, naimarkCompression_apply,
   476	    groundProjection, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, Matrix.one_apply]
   477	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   478	
   479	/-- Compression to the ground slice commutes with finite sums. -/
   480	theorem naimarkCompression_finset_sum {ι α β : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   481	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset β) (M : β → Op (ι × Option α)) :
   482	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (∑ b ∈ s, M b) =
   483	      ∑ b ∈ s, naimarkCompression (α := α) (M b) := by
   484	  ext i j
   485	  simp [Matrix.sum_apply]

   487	/-- The dilated state lies in the ground slice on Alice's side. -/
   488	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   489	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   490	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   491	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   492	      naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   493	  have hfull : applyOperatorToState
   494	      (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιB α))
   495	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   496	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   497	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   498	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]
   499	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   500	    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   501	  exact hfull

   503	/-- The dilated state lies in the ground slice on Bob's side. -/
   504	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   505	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   506	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   507	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α)) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   508	      naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   509	  have hfull : applyOperatorToState
   510	      (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιB α))
   511	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   512	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   513	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   514	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]
   515	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   516	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   517	  exact hfull

   519	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Alice's
   520	side. -/
   521	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   522	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   523	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   524	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   525	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   526	  have h : heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   527	      1 - heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1 := by
   528	    rw [heteroKron_sub_left, heteroKron_one_one]
   529	  have hsub : applyOperatorToState (1 - heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   530	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   531	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   532	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   533	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   534	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   535	  rw [h, hsub, applyOperatorToState_one, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection,
   536	    sub_self]

   538	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Bob's
   539	side. -/
   540	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   541	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   542	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   563	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/

   566	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   567	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   568	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   569	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   570	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   571	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   572	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   573	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   574	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   575	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   576	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   577	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   578	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   579	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)

   581	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   582	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   583	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   584	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   585	      Matrix.mul_one]

   860	/-- The square of a two-term leakage sum is controlled by the cell-mismatch
   861	mass. -/
   862	theorem sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le (ℓ : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (m ε : ℝ)
   863	    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
   864	    (ℓ 0 + ℓ 1) ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε := by
   865	  have h2 : ∑ b : Fin 2, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := hL
   866	  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h2
   867	  have h3 : ℓ 0 ^ 2 + ℓ 1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := h2
   868	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ℓ 0 - ℓ 1)]

   870	/-- The final arithmetic of the anticommutator transfer. -/
   871	theorem anticommutator_arith {o a x z η ε : ℝ} (ho : 0 ≤ o)
   872	    (h : o ≤ a + (x + 2 * z + 2 * η) + (z + 2 * x + 2 * η))
   873	    (hx : x ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) (hz : z ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) :
   874	    o ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a ^ 2 + 15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   875	  have h1 : o ^ 2 ≤ (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 :=
   876	    pow_le_pow_left₀ ho (by linarith) 2
   877	  have h2 : (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 ≤
   878	      3 * a ^ 2 + 3 * (3 * (x + z)) ^ 2 + 3 * (4 * η) ^ 2 := by
   879	    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 3 * (x + z)), sq_nonneg (3 * (x + z) - 4 * η),
   880	      sq_nonneg (a - 4 * η)]
   881	  have h3 : (x + z) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * z ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - z)]
   882	  nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, hx, hz]

   884	/-- Transfer of Alice's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   885	dilated strategy to the original one.  The left-hand side is
   886	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA S w` for the witness whose isometry is the composite
   887	of the dilation embedding and `φ_A`, and the distance on the right is
   888	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w'`.  The transfer costs the
   889	leakage of both dilated observables out of the ground slice, controlled by the
   890	cell-consistency masses, and the state closeness.  Blueprint
   891	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   892	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   893	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   894	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   895	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   896	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   897	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   898	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   899	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   900	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   901	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   902	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   903	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   904	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   905	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   906	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   907	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   908	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ ≤
   909	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   910	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   911	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   912	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   913	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   914	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   915	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   916	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   917	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ +
   918	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   919	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   920	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   921	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   922	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   923	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_A, naimarkInflation_obs_A]
   924	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   925	      dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   926	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   927	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   928	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   929	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   930	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   931	        dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   932	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1 *
   933	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 -
   934	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 *
   935	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   936	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   937	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 0)
   938	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 4)
   939	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   940	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   941	  -- leakage and intertwining of the two observables
   942	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   943	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   944	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   945	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   946	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i0 k0)
   947	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   948	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i4 k4)
   949	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   950	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   951	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   952	  -- product transfers
   953	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   954	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) hXc hZc
   955	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   956	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) hZc hXc
   957	  have hdXZ := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   958	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   959	  have hdZX := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   960	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   961	  -- the anticommutator on the target state
   962	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   963	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   964	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   965	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   966	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   967	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   968	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   969	    congr 1
   970	    abel
   971	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)
   972	    (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1)]
   973	  refine anticommutator_arith (norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqX hsqZ
   974	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   975	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

   111	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le`. -/
   112	theorem norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]

   118	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))

   120	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))

   122	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   123	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   124	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   125	  have hGG : groundProjection ιB α * groundProjection ιB α = groundProjection ιB α :=
   126	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq
   127	  have hGc : (groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιB α ≤ 1 :=
   128	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α)
   129	  have h1Gc : (1 - groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) ≤ 1 :=

   131	  have hstep1 : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   132	      groundProjection ιB α * (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α)))
   133	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   134	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B))
   135	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   136	    have hassoc : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   137	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   138	        groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α := by
   139	      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   140	      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (groundProjection ιB α) (groundProjection ιB α) (B * _), hGG]

   142	        groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   143	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B) *
   144	          heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α) by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one],
   145	      applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection]
   146	  have hdec : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B - A * B =
   147	      -(groundProjection ιB α * A * ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) -
   148	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B := by
   149	    noncomm_ring
   150	  have hfirst : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   151	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   152	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   153	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   154	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   155	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) =
   156	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A) * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)
   157	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   158	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   159	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA)) _
   160	  have hsecond : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))

   162	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   163	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))

   165	    have hL : (heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))ᴴ *
   166	        heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) ≤ 1 :=
   167	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul h1Gc hA)
   168	    have hYc : (heteroKron Y (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)))ᴴ * heteroKron Y 1 ≤ 1 :=
   169	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor hY
   170	    have hcomm : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) *
   171	        heteroKron Y 1 = heteroKron Y 1 * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) := by
   172	      rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   173	        Matrix.mul_one]
   174	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B) =

   178	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 B - heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) +
   179	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   180	      rw [applyOperatorToState_sub_op, sub_add_cancel]
   181	    rw [hdecB, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul _ (heteroKron Y 1), hcomm,
   182	      applyOperatorToState_mul, norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_comm (heteroKron Y 1)]

   185	    · exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hYc _
   186	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   187	          (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   188	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ =
   189	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   190	          B - A * B)) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   191	        rw [heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_sub_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   192	          applyOperatorToState_sub_op, hstep1]
   193	    _ = ‖-applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   194	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   195	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   196	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   197	        rw [hdec, heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_neg_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   198	          applyOperatorToState_neg_op]
   199	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   200	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   201	          ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   202	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   203	        refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) ?_
   204	        rw [norm_neg]
   205	    _ ≤ _ := by linarith [hfirst, hsecond]

   207	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_product_transfer_le_A`. -/
   208	theorem norm_product_transfer_le_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   209	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   210	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   211	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   212	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (A B : Op (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer))
   213	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   214	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   215	        (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   216	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   217	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   218	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   219	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB A) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB B)) ξ‖ ≤
   220	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   221	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   222	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)) (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   223	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   224	  have hGc : (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   225	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)
   226	  have hGA := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA) hGc
   227	  have hGB := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hB) hGc
   228	  have hprod : heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   229	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   230	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   231	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   232	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB A) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB B) =
   233	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   234	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   235	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)) := by
   236	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul,
   237	      conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
   238	  rw [hprod]
   239	  have hT : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   240	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   241	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B))) =
   242	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   243	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   244	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))) - heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (A * B)) := by
   245	    rw [conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
   246	  have h1 : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   247	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   248	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))))ᴴ *
   249	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   250	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   251	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))) ≤ 1 :=
   252	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
   253	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGA hGB))
   254	  have h2 : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (A * B)))ᴴ *
   255	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (A * B)) ≤ 1 :=
   256	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
   257	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hA hB))
   258	  have hswap : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   259	      (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   260	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B))) ξ =
   261	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   262	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   263	          (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)))
   264	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)) -
   265	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   266	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   267	          (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)))
   268	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ) := by
   269	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   270	  rw [hswap]
   271	  refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   272	  · rw [applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor]
   273	  · rw [hT]
   274	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le h1 h2 _

   276	/-- Transfer of Bob's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   277	dilated strategy to the original one; see `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`.
   278	The left-hand side is `msAnticommutatorDistanceB S w` for the witness whose
   279	isometry is the composite of the dilation embedding and `φ_B`. -/
   280	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   281	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   282	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   283	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   284	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   285	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   286	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   287	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   288	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   289	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   290	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   291	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   292	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   293	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   294	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   295	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ ≤
   296	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   297	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   298	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   299	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   300	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   301	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   302	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   303	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   304	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ +
   305	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   306	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   307	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   308	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   309	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   310	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_B, naimarkInflation_obs_B]
   311	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   312	      dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   313	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   314	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   315	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   316	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   317	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   318	        dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   319	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)) *
   320	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) -
   321	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) *
   322	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   323	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   324	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero
   325	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero
   326	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   327	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   328	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   329	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   330	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   331	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   332	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i0 k0)
   333	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   334	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i4 k4)
   335	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   336	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   337	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   338	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   339	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) hXc hZc
   340	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   341	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) hZc hXc
   342	  have hdXZ := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   343	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   344	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   345	  have hdZX := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   346	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   347	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   348	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   349	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   350	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   351	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   352	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   353	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   354	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   355	    congr 1
   356	    abel
   357	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))
   358	    (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)))]
   359	  refine anticommutator_arith (norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqX hsqZ
   360	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   361	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']
   362

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]

   584	      applyOperatorToState M v - applyOperatorToState N v := by
   585	  simp [applyOperatorToState]
   586	
   587	/-- The action on states respects negation of operators. -/
   588	theorem applyOperatorToState_neg_op {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   589	    (M : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   590	    applyOperatorToState (-M) v = -applyOperatorToState M v := by
   591	  simp [applyOperatorToState]
   592	
   593	/-- The one-outcome distance under the one-point uniform distribution. -/
   594	theorem opDistSq_uniform_unit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   595	    (M N : Unit → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   596	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit) M N ψ =
   597	      ‖applyOperatorToState (M () - N ()) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   598	  rw [opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
   599	  simp
   600	
   601	/-- Alice's dilated observable of a variable question, typed on the enlarged
   602	local space.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
   603	abbrev dilatedObsA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) : Op (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) :=
   604	  obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess msBitOrZero)
   605	
   606	/-- Bob's dilated observable of a totalized bit, typed on the enlarged local
   607	space.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
   608	abbrev dilatedObsB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType) (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) :
   609	    Op (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) :=
   610	  obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).postprocess f)
   611	
   612	/-- The inflation of Alice's original observable is the ground compression of
   613	her dilated observable. -/
   614	theorem naimarkInflation_obs_A (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) :
   615	    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (obsOf ((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero)) =
   616	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedObsA S x * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer := by
   617	  change naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect 0 -
   618	    ((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect 1) =
   619	    groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   620	      (dilatedEffectA S x msBitOrZero 0 - dilatedEffectA S x msBitOrZero 1) *

/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
      applyOperatorToState L
        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
      simp [applyOperatorToState]
    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
  rw [key]
  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _

/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
operator. -/
theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
      applyOperatorToState L
        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
      simp [applyOperatorToState]
    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
    simp [applyOperatorToState]
  rw [key]
  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L
          (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ')‖ ≤
        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ'‖ :=
        norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ'‖ := by
        rw [← hneg, norm_neg]

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity

/-! ## Compressions of the dilated postprocessed effects -/

/-- Compressing one of Alice's dilated postprocessed effects returns her original
postprocessed effect. -/
theorem naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    naimarkCompression (dilatedEffectA S x f b) = ((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b := by
  have h := (naimarkCompression_finset_sum (Finset.univ.filter fun a : MsAnswer => f a = b)
    fun a => ((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).effect a).trans
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => naimarkCompression_msDilatedStrategy_A_effect S x a)
  exact h

/-- Compressing one of Bob's dilated postprocessed effects returns his original
postprocessed effect. -/
theorem naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    naimarkCompression (dilatedEffectB S y f b) = ((S.B y).postprocess f).effect b := by
  have h := (naimarkCompression_finset_sum (Finset.univ.filter fun a : MsAnswer => f a = b)
    fun a => ((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).effect a).trans
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => naimarkCompression_msDilatedStrategy_B_effect S y a)
  exact h

/-- The inflation of Alice's original postprocessed effect is the ground
compression `Π P Π` of her dilated one. -/
theorem naimarkInflation_postprocess_A (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b) =
      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer := by
  rw [← naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectA, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression]

/-- The inflation of Bob's original postprocessed effect is the ground
compression `Π Q Π` of his dilated one. -/
theorem naimarkInflation_postprocess_B (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.B y).postprocess f).effect b) =
      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * dilatedEffectB S y f b *
        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer := by
  rw [← naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectB, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression]

/-- Alice's dilated effects are contractions. -/
theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (dilatedEffectA S x f b)ᴴ * dilatedEffectA S x f b ≤ 1 :=
  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess f) b

/-- Bob's dilated effects are contractions. -/
theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (dilatedEffectB S y f b)ᴴ * dilatedEffectB S y f b ≤ 1 :=
  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect (((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).postprocess f) b

/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
    applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
    noncomm_ring
  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
      applyOperatorToState_zero]
  rw [hzero, add_zero]

/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a right-placed dilated operator
and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
    applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron 1 (Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α))
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
  have hsplit : Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α =
      (1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q +
        (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) := by
    noncomm_ring
  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_right, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
      (heteroKron 1 ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)))
      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
        ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)) =
        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α) by
      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
      applyOperatorToState_zero]
  rw [hzero, add_zero]

/-! ## Transfer of the effect estimates -/

/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
    simp [applyOperatorToState]
  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
        norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [h2]
        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Bob's side. -/
theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
        (((S.B y).postprocess g).effect b)) - T) ξ‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) - T) ξ‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_B]
  have hQ := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectB S y g b
  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)
  have hBd : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)))ᴴ *
      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB hQ)
  have hBo : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
      dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)))ᴴ *
      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
        dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hQ) hG))
  set Bo : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
    dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) with hBo_def
  set Bd : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) with hBd_def
  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ =
      applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ := by
    simp [applyOperatorToState]
  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ =
      applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ''‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
    have hdiff : Bd - Bo = heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b -
        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * dilatedEffectB S y g b *
          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) := by
      rw [hBd_def, hBo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
      applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression]
    exact norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hBd hBo _
  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ‖ =
        ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ :=
        norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [h2]
        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ'')
          (applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

/-- Squaring a three-term estimate. -/
theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :
    w ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 3 * z ^ 2 := by
  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (x - z)]

/-- Summing the per-outcome estimates over the two outcomes. -/
theorem sum_sq_le_of_le (d ℓ o : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (η ε m : ℝ)
    (ho : ∀ b, 0 ≤ o b) (h : ∀ b, o b ≤ d b + ℓ b + 2 * η)
    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
    ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
  have hterm : ∀ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2 :=
    fun b => sq_le_three_mul_of_le (ho b) (h b)
  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
    _ ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hL, hm]

/-- Transfer of Alice's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
dilated strategy to the original one.  For every target family `I` and target
state `ξ`, the distance of Alice's conjugated original variable bits from `I`
is at most three times the distance of the conjugated dilated bits, plus
`216 ε` from the cell-consistency masses of a strategy of value `1 - ε`, plus
`24 η²` where `η` bounds the distance of the transported dilated state from
`ξ`.  The isometry of the original strategy is the composite of the dilation
embedding and `φ_A`, exactly as in the witness of `exists_ms_rigidity`; the
left-hand side is `msOperatorDistanceA S w j W` for that witness, and the
distance on the right is `msOperatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w' j W`.
Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
theorem ms_effect_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)

(φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
          (((S.A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
          ((((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
        (fun _ b => I b) ξ + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨i, k, rfl⟩ := every_variable_is_incident j
  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
  have hL := sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i k
  have hmis := reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i k
  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
  have h := sum_sq_le_of_le
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
      (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState
      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖)
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron
      (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)
    η ε (reverseCellMismatchMass S i k) (fun b => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun b => by
      have hb := norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A S φA φB ξ (I b) (.var (msConstraintVars i k))
        (.constraint i) msBitOrZero (constraintBitOrZero k) b
      linarith [hb, hξ'])
    hL hmis
  linarith [h]

/-- Transfer of Bob's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
dilated strategy to the original one; see `ms_effect_transfer_A`. -/
theorem ms_effect_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun _ b => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
          (((S.B (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)))
        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
        (fun _ b => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
          ((((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)))
        (fun _ b => I b) ξ + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨i, k, rfl⟩ := every_variable_is_incident j
  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
  have hL := sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i k
  have hmis := forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i k
  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
  have h := sum_sq_le_of_le
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
      (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b)) - I b) ξ‖)
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState
      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))
      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖)
    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1
      (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
        (((S.B (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) - I b) ξ‖)
    η ε (forwardCellMismatchMass S i k) (fun b => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun b => by
      have hb := norm_effect_transfer_term_le_B S φA φB ξ (I b) (.constraint i)
        (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (constraintBitOrZero k) msBitOrZero b
      linarith [hb, hξ'])
    hL hmis
  linarith [h]

/-- The state estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` transfers verbatim: the composite
isometries carry the original state exactly where `φ_A ⊗ φ_B` carries the
dilated state. -/
theorem ms_state_transfer {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
    ‖isometryTensor (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
        (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer)) S.ψ - ξ‖ =
      ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ := by
  rw [isometryTensor_comp_naimarkEmbedding]
  rfl

/-! ## Transfer of the anticommutator estimates -/

/-- Inflation respects differences. -/
theorem naimarkInflation_sub {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
    naimarkInflation (α := α) (M - N) =
      naimarkInflation (α := α) M - naimarkInflation (α := α) N := by
  ext p q
  by_cases h : p.2 = none ∧ q.2 = none <;> simp [h]

/-- The action on states respects differences of operators. -/
theorem applyOperatorToState_sub_op {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M N : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    applyOperatorToState (M - N) v =
      applyOperatorToState M v - applyOperatorToState N v := by
  simp [applyOperatorToState]

/-- The action on states respects negation of operators. -/
theorem applyOperatorToState_neg_op {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    applyOperatorToState (-M) v = -applyOperatorToState M v := by
  simp [applyOperatorToState]

/-- The one-outcome distance under the one-point uniform distribution. -/
theorem opDistSq_uniform_unit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M N : Unit → Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit) M N ψ =
      ‖applyOperatorToState (M () - N ()) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [opDistSq_eq_opFamilyDistSq, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
  simp

/-- Alice's dilated observable of a variable question, typed on the enlarged
local space.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
abbrev dilatedObsA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) : Op (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) :=
  obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess msBitOrZero)

/-- Bob's dilated observable of a totalized bit, typed on the enlarged local
space.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
abbrev dilatedObsB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType) (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) :
    Op (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) :=
  obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).postprocess f)

/-- The inflation of Alice's original observable is the ground compression of
her dilated observable. -/
theorem naimarkInflation_obs_A (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) :
    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (obsOf ((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero)) =
      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedObsA S x * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer := by
  change naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect 0 -
    ((S.A x).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect 1) =
    groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
      (dilatedEffectA S x msBitOrZero 0 - dilatedEffectA S x msBitOrZero 1) *
      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer
  rw [naimarkInflation_sub, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A,
    Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]

/-- Alice's dilated observables are contractions. -/
theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) :
    (dilatedObsA S x)ᴴ * dilatedObsA S x ≤ 1 :=
  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_obsOf _

/-- Bob's dilated observables are contractions. -/
theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) :
    (dilatedObsB S y f)ᴴ * dilatedObsB S y f ≤ 1 :=
  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_obsOf _

/-- The leakage of Alice's dilated observable out of the ground slice is bounded
by the two intertwining defects of its effects. -/
theorem norm_leak_obs_le_A (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) *
        dilatedObsA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k))) 1) (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 0) 1 -
          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 0))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 1) 1 -
          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 1))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) *
    (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 0 -
      dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 1)) 1)
    (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ≤ _
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, heteroKron_sub_left, applyOperatorToState_sub_op]
  refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
  · exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
  · exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _

/-- The intertwining defect of Alice's dilated observable against Bob's is
bounded by the two intertwining defects of the effects. -/
theorem norm_intertwine_obs_le_A (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (dilatedObsA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k))) 1 -
        heteroKron 1 (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k)))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 0) 1 -
          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 0))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState
        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 1) 1 -
          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 1))
        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
  have hsplit : heteroKron (dilatedObsA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k))) (1 : Op _) -
      heteroKron 1 (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k)) =
      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 0) 1 -
        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 0)) -
      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 1) 1 -
        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 1)) := by
    change heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 0 -
      dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero 1) (1 : Op _) -
      heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 0 -
        dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) 1) = _
    rw [heteroKron_sub_left, heteroKron_sub_right]
    abel
  rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_sub_op]
  exact norm_sub_le _ _

/-- The defect of the compressed product `Π A Π · Π B Π` against `A B` on the
dilated state is controlled by the leakage of `A` and `B` and the intertwining
defect of `B` against any right-placed contraction `Y`.  Since `Π ψ' = ψ'`,
`(Π A Π Π B Π - A B) ψ' = -(Π A (1 - Π) B) ψ' - ((1 - Π) A B) ψ'`; the first
term is bounded by the leakage of `B`, and in the second `B ψ'` is replaced by
`Y ψ'`, which commutes past `(1 - Π) A`. -/
theorem norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
    (A B : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Y : Op (ιB × Option α))
    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y ≤ 1) :
    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α *
        (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α) - A * B) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron B 1 - heteroKron 1 Y) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
  have hGG : groundProjection ιA α * groundProjection ιA α = groundProjection ιA α :=
    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq
  have hGc : (groundProjection ιA α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιA α ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α)
  have h1Gc : (1 - groundProjection ιA α)ᴴ * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) ≤ 1 :=
    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub
  have hstep1 : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A *
      groundProjection ιA α * (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B) 1)
        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
    have hassoc : groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α *
        (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α) =
        groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
end MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity

When the input families are complete measurements, the dilated projective sub-measurements can be completed by assigning the residual projector of each family to one fixed outcome; the resulting projective measurements reproduce the same correlations on the extended state, since the correlation-preservation identity forces the extended state to lie in the range of the total projector of each dilated family. This completed form, with genuinely projective measurements, is the one used in Lemma~\ref{lem:symmetric-strat}; for the proof the source refers to Theorem 5.1 of \cite{Ji2020LowIndividualDegree}, which is stated for complete measurements. ./results/telemetry/github-snapshot/open-issues.json:3239:  "body": "<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: qpbt-stage43-magic-square-rigidity -->\n### Motivation\n\nDischarge the external Magic Square self-testing boundary used by QPBT\nsoundness.
