     4	/-!
     5	# A simultaneous projective dilation of a Magic Square strategy
     6	
     7	The rigidity argument for the Magic Square game is stated for an arbitrary
     8	tensor-product strategy, whose measurements are positive operator valued
     9	measures.  The self-testing argument, however, manipulates projections.  This
    10	file removes that discrepancy by dilating an arbitrary strategy to a projective
    11	one without changing any observable quantity.
    12	
    13	Each local Hilbert space `ℂ^ι` is enlarged by one auxiliary register whose
    14	basis is indexed by `Option MsAnswer`, and the original space is identified with
    15	the *ground slice* `ℂ^ι ⊗ |⊥⟩`.  The one-measurement Naimark lemma of the low
    16	individual degree development supplies, for every question separately, a family
    17	of projections on the enlarged space whose compression to the ground slice
    18	returns the original effects; the ancilla is the same for all questions, so the
    19	identification of `ℂ^ι` with the ground slice is a single isometry serving every
    20	question at once.  Folding the deficiency `1 - ∑_a P_a` into one distinguished
    21	answer turns the dilated family into a complete projective measurement without
    22	disturbing the compression, because the original effects already sum to the
    23	identity.
    24	
    25	Since the dilated state is the image of the original state under the two ground
    26	embeddings, every Born probability, and hence the game value and all the
    27	rejection, malformed-answer, cell-consistency and parity masses of the
    28	value-to-parity layer, is unchanged.  Conversely, the local isometries produced
    29	by a rigidity argument applied to the dilated strategy compose with the ground
    30	embeddings to give local isometries of the original strategy, and the
    31	state-dependent norms occurring in the conclusion of `thm:ms-rigidity` transfer
    32	along that composition.
    33	
    34	## References
    35	
    36	The rigidity statement supported here is `thm:ms-rigidity` in
    37	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, from
    38	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`,
    39	proved in Coladangelo--Stark, Theorem 6.9.  The dilation reuses the
    40	one-measurement Naimark lemma of
    41	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`, formalized as
    42	`MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.oneMeasNaimark`.
    43	-/
    44	
    45	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    46	
    47	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity
    48	
    49	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    50	open MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective
    51	
    52	noncomputable section
    53	
    54	/-! ## Orthogonality inside a subnormalized family of projections -/
    55	
    56	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    57	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  If an orthogonal projection `P` and a
    58	positive semidefinite operator `Q` satisfy `P + Q ≤ 1`, then `P` annihilates
    59	`Q`.  Indeed `Tr(P Q)` is nonnegative because both operators are positive
    60	semidefinite, while `0 ≤ Tr(P (1 - P - Q)) = -Tr(P Q)` because `1 - P - Q` is
    61	positive semidefinite and `P` is idempotent; so the pairing vanishes and the
    62	product of two positive semidefinite operators with vanishing trace pairing is
    63	zero. -/
    64	theorem mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_of_add_le_one {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    65	    {P Q : Op d} (hP : IsProj P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hPQ : P + Q ≤ 1) :
    66	    P * Q = 0 := by
    67	  have hrest : (0 : Op d) ≤ 1 - (P + Q) := sub_nonneg.mpr hPQ
    68	  have hexpand : P * (1 - (P + Q)) = -(P * Q) := by
    69	    have hPP : P * P = P := hP.isIdempotentElem
    70	    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_add, hPP, Matrix.mul_one]
    71	    abel
    72	  have hle : Complex.re (Matrix.trace (P * Q)) ≤ 0 := by
    73	    have h := trace_mul_nonneg_of_nonneg hP.nonneg hrest
    74	    rw [hexpand] at h
    75	    simpa using h
    76	  have hge : 0 ≤ Complex.re (Matrix.trace (P * Q)) :=
    77	    trace_mul_nonneg_of_nonneg hP.nonneg hQ
    78	  exact mul_eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_trace_mul_eq_zero hP.nonneg hQ (le_antisymm hle hge)
    79	
    80	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    81	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  A finite family of orthogonal
    82	projections whose sum is at most the identity is mutually orthogonal: for two
    83	distinct indices the two projections already sum to at most the identity, so the
    84	previous lemma applies. -/
    85	theorem mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_family {d α : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    86	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {P : α → Op d} (hP : ∀ a, IsProj (P a))
    87	    (hsum : ∑ a, P a ≤ 1) {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    88	    P a * P b = 0 := by
    89	  refine mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_of_add_le_one (hP a) (hP b).nonneg ?_
    90	  refine le_trans ?_ hsum
    91	  have hpair : ∑ c ∈ ({a, b} : Finset α), P c = P a + P b := by
    92	    rw [Finset.sum_pair hab]
    93	  rw [← hpair]
    94	  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
    95	    (fun c _ _ => (hP c).nonneg)
    96	
    97	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    98	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  The sum of a mutually orthogonal
    99	family of projections is again an orthogonal projection; mutual orthogonality is
   100	supplied by the hypothesis that the sum is at most the identity. -/
   101	theorem isProj_sum_of_isProj_of_sum_le_one {d α : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   102	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {P : α → Op d} (hP : ∀ a, IsProj (P a))
   103	    (hsum : ∑ a, P a ≤ 1) :
   104	    IsProj (∑ a, P a) := by
   105	  constructor
   106	  · show (∑ a, P a) * (∑ a, P a) = ∑ a, P a
   107	    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
   108	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   109	    rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single a]
   110	    · exact (hP a).isIdempotentElem
   111	    · exact fun b _ hba => mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_family hP hsum (Ne.symm hba)
   112	    · intro ha
   113	      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) ha
   114	  · show star (∑ a, P a) = ∑ a, P a
   115	    rw [star_sum]
   116	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => (hP a).isSelfAdjoint
   117	
   118	/-! ## The ground slice of an enlarged local space -/
   119	
   120	/-- The linear map sending a vector `x` of `ℂ^ι` to `x ⊗ |⊥⟩`, where `|⊥⟩` is the
   121	basis vector of the auxiliary register `ℂ^{Option α}` indexed by the adjoined
   122	point.  Formalization-only support for the dilation used by `thm:ms-rigidity`,
   123	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   124	def naimarkEmbeddingMap (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   125	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   126	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) where
   127	  toFun x := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × Option α) ℂ).symm
   128	    (fun p => if p.2 = none then x p.1 else 0)
   129	  map_add' x y := by
   130	    ext p
   131	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   132	  map_smul' c x := by
   133	    ext p
   134	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   135	
   136	/-- The isometric identification of a local Hilbert space `ℂ^ι` with the *ground
   137	slice* `ℂ^ι ⊗ |⊥⟩` of the enlarged space `ℂ^{ι × Option α}`.  This single
   138	embedding serves every question of the dilation supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`,
   139	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   140	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   141	noncomputable def naimarkEmbedding (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   142	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   143	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) :=
   144	  LinearMap.isometryOfInner (naimarkEmbeddingMap ι α) <| by
   145	    intro x y
   146	    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, naimarkEmbeddingMap]
   147	
   148	/-- The coordinates of the ground embedding: the amplitude is carried to the
   149	auxiliary basis vector `|⊥⟩` and vanishes on the other auxiliary vectors. -/
   150	@[simp]
   151	theorem naimarkEmbedding_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   152	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (p : ι × Option α) :
   153	    naimarkEmbedding ι α x p = if p.2 = none then x p.1 else 0 := rfl
   154	
   155	/-- The compression of an operator on the enlarged space to the ground slice.
   156	Formalization-only support for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   157	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   158	def naimarkCompression {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   159	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op (ι × Option α)) : Op ι :=
   160	  M.submatrix (fun i => (i, none)) (fun j => (j, none))
   161	
   162	/-- The entries of the ground-slice compression. -/
   163	@[simp]
   164	theorem naimarkCompression_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   165	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op (ι × Option α)) (i j : ι) :
   166	    naimarkCompression (α := α) M i j = M (i, none) (j, none) := rfl
   167	
   168	/-- The compression of the zero operator to the ground slice vanishes. -/
   169	@[simp]
   170	theorem naimarkCompression_zero {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   171	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   172	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (0 : Op (ι × Option α)) = 0 := by
   173	  ext i j; simp
   174	
   175	/-- The compression to the ground slice is additive. -/
   176	theorem naimarkCompression_add {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   177	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   178	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (M + N) =
   179	      naimarkCompression (α := α) M + naimarkCompression (α := α) N := by
   180	  ext i j; simp
   181	
   182	/-- The compression to the ground slice commutes with finite sums. -/
   183	theorem naimarkCompression_sum {ι α β : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   184	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] (M : β → Op (ι × Option α)) :
   185	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (∑ b, M b) = ∑ b, naimarkCompression (α := α) (M b) := by
   186	  ext i j; simp [Matrix.sum_apply]
   187	
   188	/-- The compression of the identity to the ground slice is the identity. -/
   189	@[simp]
   190	theorem naimarkCompression_one {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   191	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   192	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (1 : Op (ι × Option α)) = 1 := by
   193	  ext i j
   194	  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply, h]
   195	
   196	/-- The operator on the enlarged space that acts as `M` on the ground slice and
   197	annihilates its orthogonal complement.  Formalization-only support for the
   198	dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   199	def naimarkInflation {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   200	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   201	  Matrix.of fun p q => if p.2 = none ∧ q.2 = none then M p.1 q.1 else 0
   202	
   203	/-- The entries of the inflation of an operator to the enlarged space. -/
   204	@[simp]
   205	theorem naimarkInflation_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   206	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) (p q : ι × Option α) :
   207	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M p q =
   208	      if p.2 = none ∧ q.2 = none then M p.1 q.1 else 0 := rfl
   209	
   210	/-- Inflating an operator to the enlarged space and compressing it back returns
   211	the original operator. -/
   212	@[simp]
   213	theorem naimarkCompression_naimarkInflation {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   214	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   215	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (naimarkInflation (α := α) M) = M := by
   216	  ext i j; simp
   217	
   218	/-- The compression to the ground slice respects differences. -/
   219	theorem naimarkCompression_sub {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   220	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   221	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (M - N) =
   222	      naimarkCompression (α := α) M - naimarkCompression (α := α) N := by
   223	  ext i j; simp
   224	
   225	/-! ## The dilated projective measurement -/
   226	
   227	/-- A one-measurement Naimark dilation of a positive operator valued measure,
   228	chosen once and for all.  It provides orthogonal projections on the enlarged
   229	space `ℂ^{d × Option α}` whose ground-slice compressions are the given effects;
   230	see `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`. -/
   231	noncomputable def naimarkData {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   232	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) : OneMeasNaimarkData α d :=
   233	  Classical.choose (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   234	
   235	/-- The chosen dilation dilates the intended measurement. -/
   236	theorem naimarkData_source {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   237	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   238	    (naimarkData M).source = M.toSubmeasurement :=
   239	  Classical.choose_spec (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   240

240	
   241	/-- The dilated projections indexed by genuine answers already sum to at most the
   242	identity, since the projection attached to the adjoined point is positive
   243	semidefinite. -/
   244	theorem naimarkData_sum_some_le_one {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   245	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   246	    ∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) ≤ 1 := by
   247	  have hsplit : ∑ oa : Option α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect oa =
   248	      (naimarkData M).liftedEffect none +
   249	        ∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) :=
   250	    Fintype.sum_option (f := fun oa => (naimarkData M).liftedEffect oa)
   251	  have hle := (naimarkData M).lifted_sum_le_one
   252	  rw [hsplit] at hle
   253	  have hnone : (0 : Op (d × Option α)) ≤ (naimarkData M).liftedEffect none :=
   254	    (naimarkData M).lifted_pos none
   255	  exact le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hnone) hle
   256	
   257	/-- The sum of the dilated projections indexed by genuine answers is itself an
   258	orthogonal projection. -/
   259	theorem naimarkData_isProj_sum_some {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   260	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   261	    IsProj (∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a)) :=
   262	  isProj_sum_of_isProj_of_sum_le_one
   263	    (fun a => (naimarkData M).lifted_isProj (some a))
   264	    (naimarkData_sum_some_le_one M)
   265	
   266	/-- The effects of the dilated measurement.  The projection attached to the
   267	answer `a` is the Naimark projection of `a`, except that the distinguished answer
   268	`a₀` also absorbs the deficiency `1 - ∑_a P_a`, which makes the family complete.
   269	Formalization-only construction supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   270	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   271	noncomputable def naimarkDilatedEffect {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   272	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   273	    Op (d × Option α) :=
   274	  (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) +
   275	    (if a = a₀ then 1 - ∑ b : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some b) else 0)
   276	
   277	/-- The dilated effects are positive semidefinite. -/
   278	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_pos {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   279	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   280	    0 ≤ naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a := by
   281	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   282	  refine add_nonneg ((naimarkData M).lifted_pos (some a)) ?_
   283	  by_cases h : a = a₀
   284	  · simpa [h] using sub_nonneg.mpr (naimarkData_sum_some_le_one M)
   285	  · simp [h]
   286	
   287	/-- The dilated effects sum to the identity. -/
   288	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_sum {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   289	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ : α) :
   290	    ∑ a : α, naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a = 1 := by
   291	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   292	  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ a₀]
   293	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_pos]
   294	  abel
   295	
   296	/-- Every dilated effect is an orthogonal projection. -/
   297	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_isProj {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   298	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   299	    IsProj (naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a) := by
   300	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   301	  by_cases h : a = a₀
   302	  · subst h
   303	    refine IsStarProjection.add
   304	      ((naimarkData M).lifted_isProj (some a)) ?_ ?_
   305	    · simpa using (naimarkData_isProj_sum_some M).one_sub
   306	    · have hmul : (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) *
   307	          ∑ b : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some b) =
   308	          (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) := by
   309	        rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single a]
   310	        · exact ((naimarkData M).lifted_isProj (some a)).isIdempotentElem
   311	        · intro b _ hba

   498	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]
   499	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   500	    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   501	  exact hfull

   505	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   506	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   508	      naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   509	  have hfull : applyOperatorToState
   510	      (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιB α))
   511	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   512	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   513	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   514	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]

   516	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]

   519	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Alice's

   521	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   522	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]

   557	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   558	
   559	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   560	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   561	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   562	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   563	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
   564	theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   565	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   566	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   567	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   568	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   569	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   570	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   571	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   572	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   573	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   574	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   575	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   576	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   577	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   578	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   579	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
   580	  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
   581	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   582	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   583	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   584	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   585	      Matrix.mul_one]
   586	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
   587	      applyOperatorToState L
   588	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
   589	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   590	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
   591	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
   592	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
   593	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   594	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
   595	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   596	  rw [key]
   597	  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   598	
   599	/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
   600	dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
   601	operator. -/
   602	theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   603	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   604	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   605	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   606	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   607	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   608	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   609	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   610	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   611	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   612	    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
   613	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   614	    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   615	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   616	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
   617	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
   618	  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   619	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
   620	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   621	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
   622	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   623	      Matrix.mul_one]
   624	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
   625	      applyOperatorToState L
   626	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
   627	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   628	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   629	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
   630	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   631	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   632	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
   633	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   634	  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   635	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   636	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   637	  rw [key]
   638	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L
   639	          (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ')‖ ≤
   640	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ'‖ :=
   641	        norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   642	    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ'‖ := by
   643	        rw [← hneg, norm_neg]
   644	
   645	end

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/
    43

    55	/-- The Born overlap of Alice's totalized variable bit with Bob's totalized
    56	constraint bit, summed over the bit, is the complement of the reverse
    57	cell-mismatch mass. -/
    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    65	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    66	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    67	      ∑ a : msGame.AnswerA, ∑ c : msGame.AnswerB,
    68	        if msBitOrZero a = b then
    69	          (if constraintBitOrZero k c = b then
    70	            outcomeWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a c else 0)
    71	        else 0 := by
    72	    intro b
    73	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    74	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    75	      heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    76	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    77	    split_ifs
    78	    · rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    79	      rfl
    80	    · simp
    81	  have htotal := outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
    82	  unfold reverseCellMismatchMass outcomeEventWeight
    83	  simp_rw [hterm]
    84	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← htotal, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    85	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    86	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    87	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    88	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    89	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    90	  by_cases h : msBitOrZero a = constraintBitOrZero k c
    91	  · simp [h]
    92	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

   152	theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :

   209	      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
   210	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))
   211	      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
   212	      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1
   213	  linarith

     4	/-!
     5	# Contractions, isometries and the ground slice of the dilation
     6	
     7	Support for the transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity` (blueprint
     8	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
     9	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`):
    10	the calculus needed to compare the dilated projective strategy of
    11	`Rigidity/Dilation.lean` with the original strategy on states.
    12	
    13	* Contractions: operators `K` with `Kᴴ K ≤ 1` do not increase norms; effects,
    14	  observables of binary measurements, orthogonal projections, tensor placements,
    15	  products and isometry conjugates are contractions.
    16	* Matrices of isometries: `Vᴴ V = 1`, the two-sided isometry image of a state
    17	  preserves norms, and a conjugated local operator acts on the transported state
    18	  as the original operator acts on the original state.
    19	* The ground projection `Π` of an enlarged local space: an orthogonal projection
    20	  fixing the dilated state, with `Π P Π` the inflation of the compression of `P`.
    21	* Leakage: the part `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of a dilated operator that leaves the ground
    22	  slice is bounded by the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any `1 ⊗ Q`,
    23	  because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `(1 ⊗ Q) ψ'`.  This is the estimate that
    24	  replaces the `≈_δ`-preservation which Naimark dilation lacks in general
    25	  (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`, blueprint
    26	  `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`).
    27	
    28	## References
    29	
    30	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    31	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    32	-/

    45	/-- Applying a product of operators is successive application. -/
    46	theorem applyOperatorToState_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    47	    (M N : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    48	    applyOperatorToState (M * N) v =
    49	      applyOperatorToState M (applyOperatorToState N v) := by
    50	  unfold applyOperatorToState
    51	  simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_mul_same]

    53	/-- The identity acts trivially. -/
    54	theorem applyOperatorToState_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    55	    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    56	    applyOperatorToState (1 : Op ι) v = v := by
    57	  simp [applyOperatorToState]

    60	theorem applyOperatorToState_add {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    61	    (M : Op ι) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    62	    applyOperatorToState M (u + v) =
    63	      applyOperatorToState M u + applyOperatorToState M v := by
    64	  simp [applyOperatorToState]

    70	      applyOperatorToState M u - applyOperatorToState M v := by

    76	    applyOperatorToState (M + N) v =
    77	      applyOperatorToState M v + applyOperatorToState N v := by

    85	/-- Applying a product of rectangular matrices is successive application. -/
    86	theorem toEuclideanLin_mul_apply {m n o : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype o]
    87	    [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq o]
    88	    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix n o ℂ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ o) :

    90	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin A (Matrix.toEuclideanLin B v) := by

    93	/-- The squared norm of `A v` is the quadratic form of `Aᴴ A` at `v`. -/
    94	theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_sq {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    95	    (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
    96	    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v‖ ^ 2 =
    97	      (inner ℂ v (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (Aᴴ * A) v)).re := by
    98	  rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self]
    99	  change (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v) (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v)).re =
   100	    (inner ℂ v ((Matrix.toEuclideanLin A).adjoint (Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v))).re
   101	  rw [LinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

   103	/-- A rectangular matrix `A` with `Aᴴ A = 1` preserves norms. -/
   104	theorem norm_toEuclideanLin_of_conjTranspose_mul_eq_one {m n : Type*} [Fintype m]
   105	    [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix m n ℂ} (hA : Aᴴ * A = 1)
   106	    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ n) :
   107	    ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin A v‖ = ‖v‖ := by
   108	  have h := norm_toEuclideanLin_sq A v
   109	  have hv : (inner ℂ v v).re = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
   110	    simpa using inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) v
   111	  have hone : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) v = v := by
   112	    simp [Matrix.toEuclideanLin]
   113	  rw [hA, hone, hv] at h
   114	  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 h

   116	/-- The squared norm of `K v` is the quadratic form of `Kᴴ K` at `v`. -/
   117	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   118	    (K : Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   119	    ‖applyOperatorToState K v‖ ^ 2 =
   120	      (inner ℂ v (applyOperatorToState (Kᴴ * K) v)).re :=
   121	  norm_toEuclideanLin_sq K v

   123	/-- An operator `K` with `Kᴴ K ≤ 1` does not increase norms. -/
   124	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   125	    {K : Op ι} (hK : Kᴴ * K ≤ 1) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   126	    ‖applyOperatorToState K v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
   127	  have h := quadratic_form_mono hK v
   128	  have hv : (inner ℂ v v).re = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
   129	    simpa using inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) v
   130	  rw [← norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, applyOperatorToState_one, hv] at h
   131	  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 h

   133	/-- The difference of two contractions at most doubles norms. -/
   134	theorem norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   135	    {A B : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   136	    ‖applyOperatorToState (A - B) v‖ ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ := by
   137	  have hsplit : applyOperatorToState (A - B) v =
   138	      applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v := by
   139	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   140	  rw [hsplit]
   141	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v‖ ≤
   142	        ‖applyOperatorToState A v‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState B v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
   143	    _ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖v‖ := add_le_add (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hA v)
   144	        (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hB v)
   145	    _ = 2 * ‖v‖ := by ring

   147	/-- Orthogonal projections are contractions. -/
   148	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   149	    {P : Op ι} (hP : IsProj P) : Pᴴ * P ≤ 1 := by
   150	  have hstar : Pᴴ = P := by
   151	    rw [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
   152	    exact hP.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
   153	  rw [hstar, hP.isIdempotentElem.eq]
   154	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hP.one_sub.nonneg

   156	/-- Products of contractions are contractions. -/
   157	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   158	    {A B : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   159	    (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) ≤ 1 := by
   160	  have h1 : (1 - Aᴴ * A).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hA
   161	  have h2 := h1.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
   162	  have h3 : Bᴴ * (1 - Aᴴ * A) * B = Bᴴ * B - (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) := by
   163	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   164	    noncomm_ring
   165	  refine le_trans ?_ hB
   166	  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← h3]
   167	  exact h2

   169	/-- Effects of a measurement are contractions. -/
   170	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   171	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (a : α) :
   172	    (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
   173	  rw [measurement_effect_hermitian]
   174	  exact le_trans (sq_le_self (M.pos a) (measurement_effect_le_one M a))
   175	    (measurement_effect_le_one M a)

   177	/-- The observable of a binary measurement is a contraction: writing
   178	`E = M_0`, the observable is `2E - 1` and `1 - (2E - 1)² = 4(E - E²) ≥ 0`. -/
   179	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_obsOf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   180	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) ι) :
   181	    (obsOf M)ᴴ * obsOf M ≤ 1 := by
   182	  have hsum : M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 = 1 := by
   183	    have h : ∑ a : Fin 2, M.effect a = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
   184	    rwa [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
   185	  have hobs : obsOf M = M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1 := by
   186	    unfold obsOf
   187	    rw [← hsum]
   188	    abel
   189	  have hH : (M.effect 0)ᴴ = M.effect 0 := measurement_effect_hermitian M 0
   190	  have hsq : 0 ≤ M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0 :=
   191	    sub_nonneg.mpr (sq_le_self (M.pos 0) (measurement_effect_le_one M 0))
   192	  rw [hobs]
   193	  have hid : (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1)ᴴ * (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1) =
   194	      1 - (4 : ℕ) • (M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0) := by
   195	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
   196	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hH]
   197	    noncomm_ring
   198	  rw [hid]
   199	  exact sub_le_self _ (nsmul_nonneg hsq 4)

   279	/-- The matrix of an isometry is a matrix isometry. -/
   280	theorem isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   281	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   282	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   283	    (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ = 1 := by
   284	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   285	  have hM : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   286	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   287	  calc
   288	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ) =
   289	        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)).adjoint.comp
   290	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)) :=
   291	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self _
   292	    _ = φ.toLinearMap.adjoint.comp φ.toLinearMap := by rw [hM]
   293	    _ = 1 := φ.adjoint_comp_self'
   294	    _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
   295	      rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]
   296	      rfl

   298	/-- The range projection `V Vᴴ` of a matrix isometry is at most the identity. -/
   299	theorem isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   300	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   301	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   302	    isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤ 1 := by
   303	  have hproj : IsProj (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) := by
   304	    constructor
   305	    · change (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) *
   306	        (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   307	      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ,
   308	        isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   309	    · change star (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   310	        isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   311	      simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   312	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hproj.one_sub.nonneg

   314	/-- Conjugation by an isometry preserves contractions. -/
   315	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   316	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   317	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') {A : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) :
   318	    (conjIsometry φ A)ᴴ * conjIsometry φ A ≤ 1 := by
   319	  rw [conjIsometry_eq]
   320	  have h1 : (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ)ᴴ *
   321	      (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   322	      isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   323	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
   324	      Matrix.mul_assoc]
   325	    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ (isometryMatrix φ),
   326	      isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   327	  rw [h1]
   328	  calc isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤
   329	        isometryMatrix φ * (1 : Op ι) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   330	        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
   331	        have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (isometryMatrix φ)
   332	        convert h using 1
   333	        simp [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
   334	    _ = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
   335	    _ ≤ 1 := isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one φ

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   289	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
   290	      applyOperatorToState_zero]
   291	  rw [hzero, add_zero]

   319	/-! ## Transfer of the effect estimates -/
   320	
   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   346	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
   347	  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   348	      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   349	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   350	        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   351	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   352	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
   353	  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   354	    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
   355	  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
   356	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   357	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
   358	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
   359	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   360	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
   361	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   362	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   363	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   365	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   366	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   367	    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
   368	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
   369	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
   370	      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   371	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   372	      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
   373	    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   374	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
   375	    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
   376	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
   377	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   378	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
   379	        norm_sub_le _ _
   380	    _ ≤ _ := by
   381	        rw [h2]
   382	        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
   383	          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

   388	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   389	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)

   409	        dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) ≤ 1 :=
   410	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB

   412	  set Bo : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   413	    dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) with hBo_def

   415	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   416	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ =
   417	      applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ := by

   111	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le`. -/
   112	theorem norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   113	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   114	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   115	    (A B : Op (ιB × Option α)) (Y : Op (ιA × Option α))
   116	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y ≤ 1) :
   117	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   118	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   119	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   120	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   121	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   122	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   123	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   124	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   125	  have hGG : groundProjection ιB α * groundProjection ιB α = groundProjection ιB α :=
   126	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq
   127	  have hGc : (groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιB α ≤ 1 :=
   128	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α)
   129	  have h1Gc : (1 - groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) ≤ 1 :=
   130	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub
   131	  have hstep1 : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   132	      groundProjection ιB α * (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α)))
   133	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   134	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B))
   135	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   136	    have hassoc : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   137	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   138	        groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α := by
   139	      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   140	      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (groundProjection ιB α) (groundProjection ιB α) (B * _), hGG]
   141	    rw [hassoc, show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   142	        groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   143	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B) *
   144	          heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α) by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one],
   145	      applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection]
   146	  have hdec : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B - A * B =
   147	      -(groundProjection ιB α * A * ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) -
   148	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B := by
   149	    noncomm_ring
   150	  have hfirst : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   151	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   152	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   153	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   154	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   155	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) =
   156	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A) * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)
   157	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   158	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   159	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA)) _
   160	  have hsecond : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   161	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   162	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   163	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   164	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   165	    have hL : (heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))ᴴ *
   166	        heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) ≤ 1 :=
   167	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul h1Gc hA)
   168	    have hYc : (heteroKron Y (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)))ᴴ * heteroKron Y 1 ≤ 1 :=
   169	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor hY
   170	    have hcomm : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) *
   171	        heteroKron Y 1 = heteroKron Y 1 * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) := by
   172	      rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   173	        Matrix.mul_one]
   174	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B) =
   175	        heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * heteroKron 1 B
   176	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   177	    have hdecB : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   178	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 B - heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) +
   179	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   180	      rw [applyOperatorToState_sub_op, sub_add_cancel]
   181	    rw [hdecB, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul _ (heteroKron Y 1), hcomm,
   182	      applyOperatorToState_mul, norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_comm (heteroKron Y 1)]
   183	    refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   184	    · exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hL _
   185	    · exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hYc _
   186	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   187	          (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   188	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ =
   189	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   190	          B - A * B)) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   191	        rw [heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_sub_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   192	          applyOperatorToState_sub_op, hstep1]
   193	    _ = ‖-applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   194	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   195	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   196	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   197	        rw [hdec, heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_neg_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   198	          applyOperatorToState_neg_op]
   199	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   200	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   201	          ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   202	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   203	        refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) ?_
   204	        rw [norm_neg]
   205	    _ ≤ _ := by linarith [hfirst, hsecond]

   276	/-- Transfer of Bob's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the

   278	The left-hand side is `msAnticommutatorDistanceB S w` for the witness whose
   279	isometry is the composite of the dilation embedding and `φ_B`. -/
   280	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   281	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   282	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   283	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   284	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   285	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   286	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   287	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   288	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   289	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   290	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   291	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   292	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   293	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   294	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   295	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ ≤
   296	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   297	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   298	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   299	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   300	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   301	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   302	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   303	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   304	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ +
   305	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   306	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   307	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   308	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   309	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   310	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_B, naimarkInflation_obs_B]
   311	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   312	      dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   313	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   314	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   315	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   316	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   317	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   318	        dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   319	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)) *
   320	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) -
   321	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) *
   322	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   323	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   324	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero
   325	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero
   326	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   327	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   328	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   329	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   330	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   331	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   332	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i0 k0)
   333	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   334	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i4 k4)
   335	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   336	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   337	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   338	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   339	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) hXc hZc
   340	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   341	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) hZc hXc
   342	  have hdXZ := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   343	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   344	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   345	  have hdZX := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   346	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   347	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   348	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   349	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   350	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   351	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   352	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   353	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   354	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]

   356	    abel
   357	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))
   358	    (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)))]
   359	  refine anticommutator_arith (norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqX hsqZ
   360	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   361	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

     4	/-!
     5	# Magic Square value-to-parity relations
     6	
     7	This file extracts the elementary probability relations used at the start of
     8	the Magic Square rigidity argument.  A strategy of value at least `1 - ε` has
     9	total rejection mass at most `ε`.  Since the question distribution is
    10	supported on at most 36 directed incidences, the rejection mass at each
    11	incidence is at most `36 * ε`.  This controls malformed answers, consistency
    12	of the two reported bits at every cell, and the parity product on each of the
    13	six row or column constraints.
    14	
    15	The arguments apply to arbitrary finite POVMs.  In particular, malformed
    16	answers remain in the event masses when `msBitOrZero` and
    17	`constraintBitOrZero` turn the common answer alphabet into binary outcomes.
    18	
    19	## References
    20	
    21	The Magic Square game is defined in
    22	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:512-610`
    23	and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:201-222`.  These relations are the
    24	probabilistic input to the rigidity result cited at paper lines 612-652 from
    25	Coladangelo--Stark, Theorem 6.9.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    29	
    30	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity
    31	
    32	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum

    36	/-! ## The directed incidence distribution -/
    37	
    38	/-- The 36 possible directed constraint-variable incidences. -/
    39	def directedIncidence : ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool) → MsType × MsType
    40	  | ((i, k), false) => (.constraint i, .var (msConstraintVars i k))
    41	  | ((i, k), true) => (.var (msConstraintVars i k), .constraint i)
    42	
    43	/-- Every question pair in the Magic Square distribution is a directed incidence. -/
    44	theorem ms_support_subset_directed_incidences :
    45	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support ⊆
    46	      (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image directedIncidence := by
    47	  intro xy hxy
    48	  have hedge : Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ msEdges :=
    49	    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxy).2
    50	  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hedge with ⟨ik, _hik, heq⟩
    51	  have heq' :
    52	      ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) = xy ∨
    53	        ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) =
    54	          xy.swap :=
    55	    (Sym2.mk_eq_mk_iff (α := MsType)).mp heq
    56	  rcases heq' with heq' | heq'
    57	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, false), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    58	    simpa [directedIncidence] using heq'
    59	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, true), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    60	    simpa [directedIncidence] using congrArg Prod.swap heq'
    61	
    62	/-- The Magic Square question distribution has at most 36 support points. -/
    63	theorem ms_support_card_le :
    64	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤ 36 := by
    65	  calc
    66	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤
    67	        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image
    68	          directedIncidence).card :=
    69	      Finset.card_le_card ms_support_subset_directed_incidences
    70	    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).card :=
    71	      Finset.card_image_le
    72	    _ = 36 := by norm_num
    73	
    74	/-- A constraint-to-variable incidence belongs to the question support. -/
    75	theorem ms_forward_incidence_mem_support (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    76	    (.constraint i, .var (msConstraintVars i k)) ∈
    77	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    78	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    79	  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    80	  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i, k), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    81	
    82	/-- A variable-to-constraint incidence belongs to the question support. -/
    83	theorem ms_reverse_incidence_mem_support (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    84	    (.var (msConstraintVars i k), .constraint i) ∈
    85	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    86	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    87	  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    88	  rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
    89	  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i, k), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    90	
    91	/-- Every supported question pair has probability at least `1 / 36`. -/
    92	theorem ms_question_weight_ge {xy : MsType × MsType}
    93	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
    94	    (1 : ℝ) / 36 ≤ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy := by
    95	  have hmemFilter :
    96	      xy ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
    97	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges) := hxy
    98	  rw [show (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy =
    99	      1 / ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card : ℝ) by
   100	    change (Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   101	        ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   102	          Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges)).weight xy =
   103	      1 / (((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   104	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges).card : ℝ)
   105	    rw [Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight, if_pos hmemFilter]]
   106	  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
   107	  · exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨xy, hxy⟩
   108	  · exact_mod_cast ms_support_card_le

   110	/-! ## Rejection mass from the game value -/
   111	
   112	/-- The rejection mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   113	noncomputable def rejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   114	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   115	
   116	/-- The acceptance mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   117	noncomputable def acceptanceMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   118	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = true
   119	
   120	/-- The rejection mass averaged over the Magic Square question distribution. -/
   121	noncomputable def totalRejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) : ℝ :=
   122	  avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   123	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2
   124	
   125	/-- Acceptance and rejection partition the conditioned answer mass. -/
   126	theorem acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   127	    acceptanceMass S x y + rejectionMass S x y = 1 := by
   128	  rw [← show (∑ a : MsAnswer, ∑ b : MsAnswer, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = 1 by
   129	    exact outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S x y]
   130	  unfold acceptanceMass rejectionMass outcomeEventWeight
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   132	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   133	  intro a _
   134	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   135	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   136	  intro b _
   137	  cases h : msWinPredicate x y a b <;> simp [h]
   138	
   139	/-- The strategy value is the average conditioned acceptance mass. -/
   140	theorem strategy_value_eq_acceptance_mass (S : Strategy msGame) :
   141	    S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   142	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 := by
   143	  rfl
   144	
   145	/-- Total rejection mass is exactly one minus the strategy value. -/
   146	theorem total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value (S : Strategy msGame) :
   147	    totalRejectionMass S = 1 - S.value := by
   148	  rw [show S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   149	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) by rfl]
   150	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   151	  calc
   152	    avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   153	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2) =
   154	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   155	          1 - acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   156	      apply avgOver_congr
   157	      intro xy
   158	      linarith [show acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 + rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 = 1 by
   159	        exact acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass S xy.1 xy.2]
   160	    _ = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun _ => 1) -
   161	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   162	          acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := avgOver_sub _ _ _
   163	    _ = 1 - avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   164	        acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   165	      rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (by
   166	        unfold graphDistribution
   167	        apply Distribution.uniformOnFinset_isProbability
   168	        refine ⟨(.constraint 0, .var (msConstraintVars 0 0)), ?_⟩
   169	        simp [msEdges])]
   170	
   171	/-- Total rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   172	theorem total_rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) :
   173	    0 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   174	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   175	  exact avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun xy => outcome_event_weight_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2 _
   176	
   177	/-- Value at least `1 - ε` implies total rejection mass at most `ε`. -/
   178	theorem total_rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   179	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) : totalRejectionMass S ≤ ε := by
   180	  rw [total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value]
   181	  linarith
   182	
   183	/-- Conditioned rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   184	theorem rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   185	    0 ≤ rejectionMass S x y :=
   186	  outcome_event_weight_nonneg S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   187	
   188	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most 36 times total rejection. -/
   189	theorem rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total (S : Strategy msGame)
   190	    {xy : MsType × MsType}
   191	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   192	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S := by
   193	  have hrejection : 0 ≤ rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   194	    rejection_mass_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2
   195	  have hweight := ms_question_weight_ge hxy
   196	  have hterm :
   197	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   198	          rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   199	    unfold totalRejectionMass avgOver
   200	    exact Finset.single_le_sum
   201	      (fun z _ => mul_nonneg
   202	        ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).nonnegative z)
   203	        (rejection_mass_nonneg S z.1 z.2)) hxy
   204	  have hscaled : (1 / 36 : ℝ) * rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤
   205	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   206	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   207	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight hrejection
   208	  nlinarith
   209	
   210	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   211	theorem rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   212	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) {xy : MsType × MsType}
   213	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   214	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * ε := by
   215	  calc
   216	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S :=
   217	      rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total S hxy
   218	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   219	      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (total_rejection_mass_le S ε hwin) (by norm_num)
   220	
   221	/-- An event which always rejects has mass at most the conditioned rejection mass. -/
   222	theorem outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType)
   223	    (E : MsAnswer → MsAnswer → Prop) [DecidableRel E]
   224	    (hE : ∀ a b, E a b → msWinPredicate x y a b = false) :
   225	    outcomeEventWeight S x y E ≤ rejectionMass S x y := by
   226	  exact outcome_event_weight_mono S x y E _ hE

   228	/-! ## Malformed answers and cell consistency -/
   229	
   230	/-- The selected constraint bit, with a wrong-form single-bit answer folded to zero. -/
   231	def constraintBitOrZero (k : Fin 3) : MsAnswer → ZMod 2
   232	  | .triple β => β k
   233	  | .bit _ => 0
   234	
   235	/-- Whether an answer has the wrong form for a variable question. -/
   236	def wrongVariableAnswer : MsAnswer → Bool
   237	  | .triple _ => true
   238	  | .bit _ => false
   239	
   240	/-- Whether an answer has the wrong form for a constraint question. -/
   241	def wrongConstraintAnswer : MsAnswer → Bool
   242	  | .triple _ => false
   243	  | .bit _ => true
   244	
   245	/-- The three cells in any fixed row or column are distinct. -/
   246	theorem constraint_vars_injective (i : Fin 6) : Function.Injective (msConstraintVars i) := by
   247	  intro k l hkl
   248	  apply Fin.ext
   249	  unfold msConstraintVars at hkl
   250	  split at hkl <;> simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at hkl ⊢ <;> omega
   251	
   252	/-- Every Magic Square variable is incident to a row constraint. -/
   253	theorem every_variable_is_incident (j : Fin 9) :
   254	    ∃ i : Fin 6, ∃ k : Fin 3, msConstraintVars i k = j := by
   255	  let i : Fin 6 := ⟨j.val / 3, by omega⟩
   256	  let k : Fin 3 := ⟨j.val % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
   257	  refine ⟨i, k, ?_⟩
   258	  apply Fin.ext
   259	  simp only [msConstraintVars, i, k]
   260	  rw [if_pos (by omega)]
   261	  omega
   262	
   263	/-- Alice's variable-answer mass folded to zero by `msBitOrZero`. -/
   264	noncomputable def aliceVariableWrongFormMass (S : Strategy msGame) (j : Fin 9) : ℝ :=
   265	  aliceEventWeight S (.var j) fun a => wrongVariableAnswer a = true
   266	
   267	/-- Bob's variable-answer mass folded to zero by `msBitOrZero`. -/
   268	noncomputable def bobVariableWrongFormMass (S : Strategy msGame) (j : Fin 9) : ℝ :=
   269	  bobEventWeight S (.var j) fun b => wrongVariableAnswer b = true
   270	
   271	/-- Alice's single-bit answer mass on a constraint question. -/
   272	noncomputable def aliceConstraintWrongFormMass (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
   273	  aliceEventWeight S (.constraint i) fun a => wrongConstraintAnswer a = true
   274	
   275	/-- Bob's single-bit answer mass on a constraint question. -/
   276	noncomputable def bobConstraintWrongFormMass (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
   277	  bobEventWeight S (.constraint i) fun b => wrongConstraintAnswer b = true
   278	
   279	private theorem forward_wrong_variable_rejects (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3)
   280	    (a b : MsAnswer) (hb : wrongVariableAnswer b = true) :
   281	    msWinPredicate (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) a b = false := by
   282	  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [wrongVariableAnswer, msWinPredicate]
   283	
   284	private theorem reverse_wrong_variable_rejects (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3)
   285	    (a b : MsAnswer) (ha : wrongVariableAnswer a = true) :
   286	    msWinPredicate (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a b = false := by
   287	  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [wrongVariableAnswer, msWinPredicate]
   288	
   289	private theorem forward_wrong_constraint_rejects (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3)
   290	    (a b : MsAnswer) (ha : wrongConstraintAnswer a = true) :
   291	    msWinPredicate (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) a b = false := by
   292	  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all [wrongConstraintAnswer, msWinPredicate]
   293	
   294	private theorem reverse_wrong_constraint_rejects (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3)
   295	    (a b : MsAnswer) (hb : wrongConstraintAnswer b = true) :
   296	    msWinPredicate (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a b = false := by

   298	
   299	/-- Alice's wrong-form mass at every variable question is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   300	theorem alice_variable_wrong_form_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   301	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9) :
   302	    aliceVariableWrongFormMass S j ≤ 36 * ε := by
   303	  rcases every_variable_is_incident j with ⟨i, k, hj⟩
   304	  rw [← hj]
   305	  unfold aliceVariableWrongFormMass
   306	  rw [← outcome_event_weight_left_eq S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)]
   307	  calc
   308	    outcomeEventWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
   309	        (fun a _ => wrongVariableAnswer a = true) ≤
   310	        rejectionMass S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) :=
   311	      outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass S _ _ _ (reverse_wrong_variable_rejects i k)
   312	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   313	      rejection_mass_le S ε hwin (ms_reverse_incidence_mem_support i k)
   314	
   315	/-- Bob's wrong-form mass at every variable question is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   316	theorem bob_variable_wrong_form_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   317	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9) :
   318	    bobVariableWrongFormMass S j ≤ 36 * ε := by
   319	  rcases every_variable_is_incident j with ⟨i, k, hj⟩
   320	  rw [← hj]
   321	  unfold bobVariableWrongFormMass
   322	  rw [← outcome_event_weight_right_eq S (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k))]
   323	  calc
   324	    outcomeEventWeight S (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k))
   325	        (fun _ b => wrongVariableAnswer b = true) ≤
   326	        rejectionMass S (.constraint i) (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) :=
   327	      outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass S _ _ _ (forward_wrong_variable_rejects i k)
   328	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   329	      rejection_mass_le S ε hwin (ms_forward_incidence_mem_support i k)

   331	/-- Alice's wrong-form mass on every constraint question is at most `36 * ε`. -/
