+/-! ## The dilated effects on the enlarged ground spaces -/
+
+/-- Alice's dilated postprocessed effect, typed on the enlarged local space
+`ℂ^{ιA × Option MsAnswer}`.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
+abbrev dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2)
+    (b : ZMod 2) : Op (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) :=
+  (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess f).effect b
+
+/-- Bob's dilated postprocessed effect, typed on the enlarged local space
+`ℂ^{ιB × Option MsAnswer}`.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
+abbrev dilatedEffectB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType) (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2)
+    (b : ZMod 2) : Op (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) :=
+  (((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).postprocess f).effect b
+
+/-- Alice's dilated variable bit approximately intertwines with Bob's dilated
+constraint bit: the summed squared defect is at most twice the reverse
+cell-mismatch mass of the original strategy.  This is the first item of
+`fact:agreement` (blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:245-254`) applied to the
+dilated strategy, whose Born masses are those of the original one. -/
+theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
+    ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
+          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
+  set S' := msDilatedStrategy S
+  set PA := (S'.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero
+  set QB := (S'.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)
+  have h1 := point_distance_le_two_defect (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA)
+    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB) S'.ψ
+  rw [point_defect_eq] at h1
+  have hnorm : ‖S'.ψ‖ = 1 := S'.ψ_norm
+  have hover : ∑ a : ZMod 2, stateQForm S'.ψ
+      ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA).effect a *
+        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =
+      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
+    rw [← ms_dilated_strategy_reverse_cell_mismatch_mass S i k,
+      ← sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq S' i k]
+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
+    change stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) 1 * heteroKron 1 (QB.effect a)) =
+      stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) (QB.effect a))
+    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
+  rw [hnorm, hover] at h1
+  have h2 : ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
+        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
+      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1
+  linarith
+
+/-- Alice's dilated constraint bit approximately intertwines with Bob's dilated
+variable bit: the summed squared defect is at most twice the forward
+cell-mismatch mass of the original strategy. -/
+theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
+    ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
+          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * forwardCellMismatchMass S i k := by
+  set S' := msDilatedStrategy S
+  set PA := (S'.A (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)
+  set QB := (S'.B (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero
+  have h1 := point_distance_le_two_defect (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA)
+    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB) S'.ψ
+  rw [point_defect_eq] at h1
+  have hnorm : ‖S'.ψ‖ = 1 := S'.ψ_norm
+  have hover : ∑ a : ZMod 2, stateQForm S'.ψ
+      ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA).effect a *
+        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =
+      1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k := by
+    rw [← ms_dilated_strategy_forward_cell_mismatch_mass S i k,
+      ← sum_stateQForm_forward_eq S' i k]
+    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
+    change stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) 1 * heteroKron 1 (QB.effect a)) =
+      stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) (QB.effect a))
+    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
+  rw [hnorm, hover] at h1
+  have h2 : ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
+        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))
+      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
+      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1
+  linarith
+
+/-! ## Compressions of the dilated postprocessed effects -/
+
+/-- Compressing one of Alice's dilated postprocessed effects returns her original
+postprocessed effect. -/
+theorem naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    naimarkCompression (dilatedEffectA S x f b) = ((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b := by
+  have h := (naimarkCompression_finset_sum (Finset.univ.filter fun a : MsAnswer => f a = b)
+    fun a => ((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).effect a).trans
+    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => naimarkCompression_msDilatedStrategy_A_effect S x a)
+  exact h
+
+/-- Compressing one of Bob's dilated postprocessed effects returns his original
+postprocessed effect. -/
+theorem naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    naimarkCompression (dilatedEffectB S y f b) = ((S.B y).postprocess f).effect b := by
+  have h := (naimarkCompression_finset_sum (Finset.univ.filter fun a : MsAnswer => f a = b)
+    fun a => ((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).effect a).trans
+    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => naimarkCompression_msDilatedStrategy_B_effect S y a)
+  exact h
+
+/-- The inflation of Alice's original postprocessed effect is the ground
+compression `Π P Π` of her dilated one. -/
+theorem naimarkInflation_postprocess_A (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b) =
+      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
+        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer := by
+  rw [← naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectA, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression]
+
+/-- The inflation of Bob's original postprocessed effect is the ground
+compression `Π Q Π` of his dilated one. -/
+theorem naimarkInflation_postprocess_B (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    naimarkInflation (α := MsAnswer) (((S.B y).postprocess f).effect b) =
+      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * dilatedEffectB S y f b *
+        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer := by
+  rw [← naimarkCompression_dilatedEffectB, naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression]
+
+/-- Alice's dilated effects are contractions. -/
+theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    (dilatedEffectA S x f b)ᴴ * dilatedEffectA S x f b ≤ 1 :=
+  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess f) b
+
+/-- Bob's dilated effects are contractions. -/
+theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectB (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType)
+    (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    (dilatedEffectB S y f b)ᴴ * dilatedEffectB S y f b ≤ 1 :=
+  conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect (((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).postprocess f) b
+
+/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
+and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
+theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
+    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
+    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
+    applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
+        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
+      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
+        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
+  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
+      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
+        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
+    noncomm_ring
+  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
+  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
+      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
+    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
+        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
+        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
+      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
+      applyOperatorToState_zero]
+  rw [hzero, add_zero]
+
+/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a right-placed dilated operator
+and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
+theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
+    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
+    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
+    applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron 1 (Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α))
+        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
+      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
+        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
+  have hsplit : Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α =
+      (1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q +
+        (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) := by
+    noncomm_ring
+  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_right, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
+  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron 1 ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)))
+      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
+    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
+        ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)) =
+        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α) by
+      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
+      applyOperatorToState_zero]
+  rw [hzero, add_zero]
+
+/-! ## Transfer of the effect estimates -/
+
+/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
+the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
+`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
+intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
+the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
+state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
+theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
+    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
+    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
+    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
+        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
+      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
+      ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
+      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
+  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
+  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
+  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
+  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
+      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
+  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
+      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
+      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
+        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
+      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
+  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
+    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
+  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
+  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
+  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
+      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
+    simp [applyOperatorToState]
+  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
+      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
+  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
+      ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
+    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
+        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
+          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
+      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
+    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
+      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
+    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
+  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
+    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
+  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
+        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
+    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
+        norm_sub_le _ _
+    _ ≤ _ := by
+        rw [h2]
+        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
+          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]
+
+/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Bob's side. -/
+theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
+    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
+    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
+    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
+    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
+        (((S.B y).postprocess g).effect b)) - T) ξ‖ ≤
+      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) - T) ξ‖ +
+      ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
+      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
+  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_B]
+  have hQ := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectB S y g b
+  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)
+  have hBd : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)))ᴴ *
+      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB hQ)
+  have hBo : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
+      dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)))ᴴ *
+      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
+        dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) ≤ 1 :=
+    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
+      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hQ) hG))
+  set Bo : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
+    dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) with hBo_def
+  set Bd : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) with hBd_def
+  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
+  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ =
+      applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ := by
+    simp [applyOperatorToState]
+  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ =
+      applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
+    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
+  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ''‖ ≤
+      ‖applyOperatorToState
+        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
+        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
+    have hdiff : Bd - Bo = heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b -
+        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * dilatedEffectB S y g b *
+          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) := by
+      rw [hBd_def, hBo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
+    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
+      applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression]
+    exact norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
+  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
+    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hBd hBo _
+  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ‖ =
+        ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
+    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ :=
+        norm_sub_le _ _
+    _ ≤ _ := by
+        rw [h2]
+        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ'')
+          (applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]
+
+/-- Squaring a three-term estimate. -/
+theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :
+    w ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 3 * z ^ 2 := by
+  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2
+  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (x - z)]
+
+/-- Summing the per-outcome estimates over the two outcomes. -/
+theorem sum_sq_le_of_le (d ℓ o : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (η ε m : ℝ)
+    (ho : ∀ b, 0 ≤ o b) (h : ∀ b, o b ≤ d b + ℓ b + 2 * η)
+    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
+    ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
+  have hterm : ∀ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2 :=
+    fun b => sq_le_three_mul_of_le (ho b) (h b)
+  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
+        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
+    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
+        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
+          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
+        push_cast
+        ring
+    _ ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hL, hm]
+
+/-- Transfer of Alice's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
+dilated strategy to the original one.  For every target family `I` and target
+state `ξ`, the distance of Alice's conjugated original variable bits from `I`
+is at most three times the distance of the conjugated dilated bits, plus
+`216 ε` from the cell-consistency masses of a strategy of value `1 - ε`, plus
+`24 η²` where `η` bounds the distance of the transported dilated state from
+`ξ`.  The isometry of the original strategy is the composite of the dilation
+embedding and `φ_A`, exactly as in the witness of `exists_ms_rigidity`; the
+left-hand side is `msOperatorDistanceA S w j W` for that witness, and the
+distance on the right is `msOperatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w' j W`.
+Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
+theorem ms_effect_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
+    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
+    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
+    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
+    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
+        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
+          (((S.A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
+        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
+      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
+        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
+          ((((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
+        (fun _ b => I b) ξ + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
+  obtain ⟨i, k, rfl⟩ := every_variable_is_incident j
+  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
+  have hL := sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i k
+  have hmis := reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i k
+  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
+  have h := sum_sq_le_of_le
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
+      (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
+        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
+      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖)
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron
+      (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
+        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)
+    η ε (reverseCellMismatchMass S i k) (fun b => norm_nonneg _)
+    (fun b => by
+      have hb := norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A S φA φB ξ (I b) (.var (msConstraintVars i k))
+        (.constraint i) msBitOrZero (constraintBitOrZero k) b
+      linarith [hb, hξ'])
+    hL hmis
+  linarith [h]
+
+/-- Transfer of Bob's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
+dilated strategy to the original one; see `ms_effect_transfer_A`. -/
+theorem ms_effect_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
+    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
+    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
+    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
+    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
+    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
+        (fun _ b => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
+          (((S.B (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)))
+        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
+      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
+        (fun _ b => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
+          ((((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)))
+        (fun _ b => I b) ξ + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
+  obtain ⟨i, k, rfl⟩ := every_variable_is_incident j
+  rw [opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit, opFamilyDistSq_uniform_unit]
+  have hL := sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i k
+  have hmis := forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i k
+  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
+  have h := sum_sq_le_of_le
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
+      (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b)) - I b) ξ‖)
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState
+      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
+        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))
+      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖)
+    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1
+      (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
+        (((S.B (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) - I b) ξ‖)
+    η ε (forwardCellMismatchMass S i k) (fun b => norm_nonneg _)
+    (fun b => by
+      have hb := norm_effect_transfer_term_le_B S φA φB ξ (I b) (.constraint i)
+        (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (constraintBitOrZero k) msBitOrZero b
+      linarith [hb, hξ'])
+    hL hmis
+  linarith [h]
+
+/-- The state estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` transfers verbatim: the composite
+isometries carry the original state exactly where `φ_A ⊗ φ_B` carries the
+dilated state. -/
+theorem ms_state_transfer {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
+    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
+    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
+    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
+    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) :
+    ‖isometryTensor (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
+        (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer)) S.ψ - ξ‖ =
+      ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ := by
+  rw [isometryTensor_comp_naimarkEmbedding]
+  rfl
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity

+/-- Conjugating an operator by the ground embedding followed by a later local
+isometry is conjugating its inflation by that isometry.  This is the form in
+which the conclusions of a self-testing argument applied to the dilated strategy
+are read back on the original strategy. -/
+theorem conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding {ι α κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
+    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) (M : Op ι) :

+      conjIsometry φ (naimarkInflation (α := α) M) := by
+  rw [conjIsometry_comp, conjIsometry_naimarkEmbedding]

+      (S.B y).effect b :=
+  naimarkCompression_naimarkDilatedEffect (α := MsAnswer) (S.B y) (MsAnswer.bit 0) b

     3	/-!
     4	# Finite-dimensional state transformations
     5	
     6	This file defines the tensor and reindexing operations used for strategy
     7	distance, Magic Square rigidity, and the qudit-to-qubit isomorphism. See
     8	blueprint chapters 11--13 and the declaration-level references below.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	open scoped Matrix
    12	
    13	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    14	
    15	open MIPStarRE.Quantum
    16	
    17	/-- Conjugation by the local isometries in `thm:ms-rigidity` and
    18	`lem:pauli-binary`; blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244` and
    19	`ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:710-741`, paper
    20	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652` and
    21	`04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
    22	noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    23	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    24	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    25	    (M : Op ι) : Op ι' :=
    26	  let U : Matrix ι' ι ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
    27	  U * M * Uᴴ
    28	
    29	/-- Coordinate transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    30	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    31	noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    32	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    33	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=
    34	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι' ℂ).symm
    35	    (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))
    36	
    37	/-- Apply the two independent local isometries of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    38	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    39	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    40	noncomputable def isometryTensor
    41	    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    42	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    43	    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    44	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    45	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    46	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    47	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
    48	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm
    49	    (fun p =>
    50	      ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
    51	        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κA ℂ)
    52	            (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1) *
    53	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κB ℂ)
    54	            (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2) *
    55	          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA × ιB) ℂ) ψ (i, j)))
    56	
    57	/-- Coordinate tensor used in the ideal state of `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    58	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    59	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    60	noncomputable def vecTensor {ι κ : Type*}
    61	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    62	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    63	    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ) :=
    64	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × κ) ℂ).symm
    65	    (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ u) p.1 * (EuclideanSpace.equiv κ ℂ v) p.2)
    66	
    67	/-- Operator transport used by `def:strategy-distance`, blueprint
    68	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:228-237`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
    69	def reindexOp {ι ι' : Type*} (e : ι ≃ ι') (M : Op ι') : Op ι :=
    70	  (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm) M
    71	
    72	/-- Four-factor tensor shuffle used by `thm:ms-rigidity`; blueprint
    73	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:222-244`, paper
    74	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
    75	def prodShuffle {α β γ δ : Type*} :
    76	    (α × β) × (γ × δ) ≃ (α × γ) × (β × δ) where
    77	  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    78	  invFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
    79	  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    80	  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl
    81

   151	dilated strategy, whose Born masses are those of the original one. -/

   155	          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))

   179	      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1

     4	/-!
     5	# A simultaneous projective dilation of a Magic Square strategy
     6	
     7	The rigidity argument for the Magic Square game is stated for an arbitrary
     8	tensor-product strategy, whose measurements are positive operator valued
     9	measures.  The self-testing argument, however, manipulates projections.  This
    10	file removes that discrepancy by dilating an arbitrary strategy to a projective
    11	one without changing any observable quantity.
    12	
    13	Each local Hilbert space `ℂ^ι` is enlarged by one auxiliary register whose
    14	basis is indexed by `Option MsAnswer`, and the original space is identified with
    15	the *ground slice* `ℂ^ι ⊗ |⊥⟩`.  The one-measurement Naimark lemma of the low
    16	individual degree development supplies, for every question separately, a family
    17	of projections on the enlarged space whose compression to the ground slice
    18	returns the original effects; the ancilla is the same for all questions, so the
    19	identification of `ℂ^ι` with the ground slice is a single isometry serving every
    20	question at once.  Folding the deficiency `1 - ∑_a P_a` into one distinguished
    21	answer turns the dilated family into a complete projective measurement without
    22	disturbing the compression, because the original effects already sum to the
    23	identity.
    24	
    25	Since the dilated state is the image of the original state under the two ground
    26	embeddings, every Born probability, and hence the game value and all the
    27	rejection, malformed-answer, cell-consistency and parity masses of the
    28	value-to-parity layer, is unchanged.  Conversely, the local isometries produced
    29	by a rigidity argument applied to the dilated strategy compose with the ground
    30	embeddings to give local isometries of the original strategy, and the
    31	state-dependent norms occurring in the conclusion of `thm:ms-rigidity` transfer
    32	along that composition.
    33	
    34	## References
    35	
    36	The rigidity statement supported here is `thm:ms-rigidity` in
    37	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, from
    38	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`,
    39	proved in Coladangelo--Stark, Theorem 6.9.  The dilation reuses the
    40	one-measurement Naimark lemma of
    41	`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`, formalized as
    42	`MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.oneMeasNaimark`.
    43	-/
    44	
    45	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    46	
    47	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity
    48	
    49	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    50	open MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective

    52	noncomputable section
    53	
    54	/-! ## Orthogonality inside a subnormalized family of projections -/
    55	
    56	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    57	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  If an orthogonal projection `P` and a
    58	positive semidefinite operator `Q` satisfy `P + Q ≤ 1`, then `P` annihilates
    59	`Q`.  Indeed `Tr(P Q)` is nonnegative because both operators are positive
    60	semidefinite, while `0 ≤ Tr(P (1 - P - Q)) = -Tr(P Q)` because `1 - P - Q` is
    61	positive semidefinite and `P` is idempotent; so the pairing vanishes and the
    62	product of two positive semidefinite operators with vanishing trace pairing is
    63	zero. -/
    64	theorem mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_of_add_le_one {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    65	    {P Q : Op d} (hP : IsProj P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hPQ : P + Q ≤ 1) :
    66	    P * Q = 0 := by
    67	  have hrest : (0 : Op d) ≤ 1 - (P + Q) := sub_nonneg.mpr hPQ
    68	  have hexpand : P * (1 - (P + Q)) = -(P * Q) := by
    69	    have hPP : P * P = P := hP.isIdempotentElem
    70	    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_add, hPP, Matrix.mul_one]
    71	    abel
    72	  have hle : Complex.re (Matrix.trace (P * Q)) ≤ 0 := by
    73	    have h := trace_mul_nonneg_of_nonneg hP.nonneg hrest
    74	    rw [hexpand] at h
    75	    simpa using h
    76	  have hge : 0 ≤ Complex.re (Matrix.trace (P * Q)) :=
    77	    trace_mul_nonneg_of_nonneg hP.nonneg hQ
    78	  exact mul_eq_zero_of_nonneg_of_trace_mul_eq_zero hP.nonneg hQ (le_antisymm hle hge)
    79	
    80	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    81	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  A finite family of orthogonal
    82	projections whose sum is at most the identity is mutually orthogonal: for two
    83	distinct indices the two projections already sum to at most the identity, so the
    84	previous lemma applies. -/
    85	theorem mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_family {d α : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    86	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {P : α → Op d} (hP : ∀ a, IsProj (P a))
    87	    (hsum : ∑ a, P a ≤ 1) {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    88	    P a * P b = 0 := by
    89	  refine mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_of_add_le_one (hP a) (hP b).nonneg ?_
    90	  refine le_trans ?_ hsum
    91	  have hpair : ∑ c ∈ ({a, b} : Finset α), P c = P a + P b := by
    92	    rw [Finset.sum_pair hab]
    93	  rw [← hpair]
    94	  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
    95	    (fun c _ _ => (hP c).nonneg)
    96	
    97	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`
    98	(blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`).  The sum of a mutually orthogonal
    99	family of projections is again an orthogonal projection; mutual orthogonality is
   100	supplied by the hypothesis that the sum is at most the identity. -/
   101	theorem isProj_sum_of_isProj_of_sum_le_one {d α : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
   102	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {P : α → Op d} (hP : ∀ a, IsProj (P a))
   103	    (hsum : ∑ a, P a ≤ 1) :
   104	    IsProj (∑ a, P a) := by
   105	  constructor
   106	  · show (∑ a, P a) * (∑ a, P a) = ∑ a, P a
   107	    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
   108	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   109	    rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single a]
   110	    · exact (hP a).isIdempotentElem
   111	    · exact fun b _ hba => mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_family hP hsum (Ne.symm hba)
   112	    · intro ha
   113	      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) ha
   114	  · show star (∑ a, P a) = ∑ a, P a
   115	    rw [star_sum]
   116	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => (hP a).isSelfAdjoint
   117	
   118	/-! ## The ground slice of an enlarged local space -/
   119	
   120	/-- The linear map sending a vector `x` of `ℂ^ι` to `x ⊗ |⊥⟩`, where `|⊥⟩` is the
   121	basis vector of the auxiliary register `ℂ^{Option α}` indexed by the adjoined
   122	point.  Formalization-only support for the dilation used by `thm:ms-rigidity`,
   123	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   124	def naimarkEmbeddingMap (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   125	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   126	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) where
   127	  toFun x := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × Option α) ℂ).symm
   128	    (fun p => if p.2 = none then x p.1 else 0)
   129	  map_add' x y := by
   130	    ext p
   131	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   132	  map_smul' c x := by
   133	    ext p
   134	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   135	
   136	/-- The isometric identification of a local Hilbert space `ℂ^ι` with the *ground
   137	slice* `ℂ^ι ⊗ |⊥⟩` of the enlarged space `ℂ^{ι × Option α}`.  This single
   138	embedding serves every question of the dilation supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`,

     5	# Contractions, isometries and the ground slice of the dilation
     6	
     7	Support for the transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity` (blueprint
     8	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
     9	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`):
    10	the calculus needed to compare the dilated projective strategy of
    11	`Rigidity/Dilation.lean` with the original strategy on states.
    12	
    13	* Contractions: operators `K` with `Kᴴ K ≤ 1` do not increase norms; effects,
    14	  observables of binary measurements, orthogonal projections, tensor placements,
    15	  products and isometry conjugates are contractions.
    16	* Matrices of isometries: `Vᴴ V = 1`, the two-sided isometry image of a state
    17	  preserves norms, and a conjugated local operator acts on the transported state
    18	  as the original operator acts on the original state.
    19	* The ground projection `Π` of an enlarged local space: an orthogonal projection
    20	  fixing the dilated state, with `Π P Π` the inflation of the compression of `P`.

    22	  slice is bounded by the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any `1 ⊗ Q`,

   138	      applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v := by
   139	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   140	  rw [hsplit]
   141	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState A v - applyOperatorToState B v‖ ≤
   142	        ‖applyOperatorToState A v‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState B v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
   143	    _ ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖v‖ := add_le_add (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hA v)
   144	        (norm_applyOperatorToState_le hB v)
   145	    _ = 2 * ‖v‖ := by ring

   156	/-- Products of contractions are contractions. -/
   157	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   158	    {A B : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   159	    (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) ≤ 1 := by
   160	  have h1 : (1 - Aᴴ * A).PosSemidef := Matrix.le_iff.mp hA
   161	  have h2 := h1.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same B
   162	  have h3 : Bᴴ * (1 - Aᴴ * A) * B = Bᴴ * B - (A * B)ᴴ * (A * B) := by
   163	    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   164	    noncomm_ring
   165	  refine le_trans ?_ hB
   166	  rw [Matrix.le_iff, ← h3]
   167	  exact h2

   169	/-- Effects of a measurement are contractions. -/
   170	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_effect {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
   171	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (a : α) :
   172	    (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
   173	  rw [measurement_effect_hermitian]
   174	  exact le_trans (sq_le_self (M.pos a) (measurement_effect_le_one M a))

   177	/-- The observable of a binary measurement is a contraction: writing
   178	`E = M_0`, the observable is `2E - 1` and `1 - (2E - 1)² = 4(E - E²) ≥ 0`. -/
   179	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_obsOf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   180	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) ι) :
   181	    (obsOf M)ᴴ * obsOf M ≤ 1 := by
   182	  have hsum : M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 = 1 := by
   183	    have h : ∑ a : Fin 2, M.effect a = 1 := M.sum_eq_one
   184	    rwa [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
   185	  have hobs : obsOf M = M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1 := by
   186	    unfold obsOf
   187	    rw [← hsum]
   188	    abel
   189	  have hH : (M.effect 0)ᴴ = M.effect 0 := measurement_effect_hermitian M 0
   190	  have hsq : 0 ≤ M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0 :=
   191	    sub_nonneg.mpr (sq_le_self (M.pos 0) (measurement_effect_le_one M 0))
   192	  rw [hobs]
   193	  have hid : (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1)ᴴ * (M.effect 0 + M.effect 0 - 1) =
   194	      1 - (4 : ℕ) • (M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 0) := by
   195	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sub, Matrix.conjTranspose_add,
   196	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one, hH]
   197	    noncomm_ring
   198	  rw [hid]
   199	  exact sub_le_self _ (nsmul_nonneg hsq 4)

   279	/-- The matrix of an isometry is a matrix isometry. -/
   280	theorem isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   281	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   282	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   283	    (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ = 1 := by
   284	  apply Matrix.toEuclideanLin.injective
   285	  have hM : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   286	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   287	  calc
   288	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ * isometryMatrix φ) =
   289	        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)).adjoint.comp
   290	          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ)) :=
   291	      Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_mul_self _
   292	    _ = φ.toLinearMap.adjoint.comp φ.toLinearMap := by rw [hM]
   293	    _ = 1 := φ.adjoint_comp_self'
   294	    _ = Matrix.toEuclideanLin (1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
   295	      rw [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_one]
   296	      rfl

   300	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   301	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') :
   302	    isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤ 1 := by
   303	  have hproj : IsProj (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) := by
   304	    constructor
   305	    · change (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) *
   306	        (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   307	      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ,
   308	        isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   309	    · change star (isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   310	        isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ
   311	      simp [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
   312	  exact sub_nonneg.mp hproj.one_sub.nonneg

   314	/-- Conjugation by an isometry preserves contractions. -/
   315	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   316	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   317	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') {A : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) :
   318	    (conjIsometry φ A)ᴴ * conjIsometry φ A ≤ 1 := by
   319	  rw [conjIsometry_eq]
   320	  have h1 : (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ)ᴴ *
   321	      (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   322	      isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   323	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
   324	      Matrix.mul_assoc]
   325	    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ (isometryMatrix φ),
   326	      isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   327	  rw [h1]
   328	  calc isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤
   329	        isometryMatrix φ * (1 : Op ι) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   330	        rw [Matrix.le_iff]
   331	        have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (isometryMatrix φ)
   332	        convert h using 1
   333	        simp [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]
   334	    _ = isometryMatrix φ * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
   335	    _ ≤ 1 := isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one φ

   497	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   498	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]

   557	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   558	
   559	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   560	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   561	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   562	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   563	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
   564	theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   565	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   566	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   567	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   568	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   569	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   570	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   571	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   572	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   573	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   574	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   575	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   576	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   577	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   578	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   579	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
   580	  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
   581	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   582	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   583	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   584	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   585	      Matrix.mul_one]
   586	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
   587	      applyOperatorToState L
   588	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
   589	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   590	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
   591	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
   592	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
   593	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   594	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
   595	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   596	  rw [key]
   597	  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   598	
   599	/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
   600	dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
   601	operator. -/
   602	theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   603	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   604	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   605	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   606	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   607	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   608	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   609	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   610	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   611	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   612	    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
   613	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   614	    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   615	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   616	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
   617	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
   618	  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   619	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
   620	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   621	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
   622	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   623	      Matrix.mul_one]
   624	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
   625	      applyOperatorToState L
   626	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
   627	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   628	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   629	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
   630	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   631	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   632	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
   633	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   634	  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   635	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   636	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   637	  rw [key]
   638	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L
   639	          (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ')‖ ≤
   640	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ'‖ :=
   641	        norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   642	    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ'‖ := by
   643	        rw [← hneg, norm_neg]

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/
    43

    55	/-- The Born overlap of Alice's totalized variable bit with Bob's totalized
    56	constraint bit, summed over the bit, is the complement of the reverse
    57	cell-mismatch mass. -/
    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    65	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    66	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    67	      ∑ a : msGame.AnswerA, ∑ c : msGame.AnswerB,
    68	        if msBitOrZero a = b then
    69	          (if constraintBitOrZero k c = b then
    70	            outcomeWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a c else 0)
    71	        else 0 := by
    72	    intro b
    73	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    74	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    75	      heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    76	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    77	    split_ifs
    78	    · rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    79	      rfl
    80	    · simp
    81	  have htotal := outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
    82	  unfold reverseCellMismatchMass outcomeEventWeight
    83	  simp_rw [hterm]
    84	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← htotal, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    85	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    86	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    87	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    88	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    89	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    90	  by_cases h : msBitOrZero a = constraintBitOrZero k c
    91	  · simp [h]
    92	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

   191	  set PA := (S'.A (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)
   192	  set QB := (S'.B (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero

   195	  rw [point_defect_eq] at h1

   198	      ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA).effect a *
   199	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =
   200	      1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k := by
   201	    rw [← ms_dilated_strategy_forward_cell_mismatch_mass S i k,
   202	      ← sum_stateQForm_forward_eq S' i k]

   209	      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b) 1 -
   210	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b))

   212	      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - forwardCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   289	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
   290	      applyOperatorToState_zero]
   291	  rw [hzero, add_zero]

   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   346	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
   347	  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   348	      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   349	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   350	        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   351	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   352	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
   353	  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   354	    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
   355	  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
   356	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   357	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
   358	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
   359	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   360	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
   361	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   362	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   363	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   365	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   366	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   367	    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
   368	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
   369	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
   370	      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   371	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   372	      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
   373	    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   374	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
   375	    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
   376	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
   377	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   378	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
   379	        norm_sub_le _ _
   380	    _ ≤ _ := by
   381	        rw [h2]
   382	        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
   383	          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

   430	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,

   432	    exact norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   433	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=

   444	/-- Squaring a three-term estimate. -/
   445	theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :
   446	    w ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 3 * z ^ 2 := by
   447	  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2
   448	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (x - z)]

   450	/-- Summing the per-outcome estimates over the two outcomes. -/
   451	theorem sum_sq_le_of_le (d ℓ o : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (η ε m : ℝ)
   452	    (ho : ∀ b, 0 ≤ o b) (h : ∀ b, o b ≤ d b + ℓ b + 2 * η)
   453	    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
   454	    ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
   455	  have hterm : ∀ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2 :=
   456	    fun b => sq_le_three_mul_of_le (ho b) (h b)
   457	  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
   458	        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
   459	    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
   460	        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
   461	          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
   462	        push_cast
   463	        ring
   464	    _ ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hL, hm]

   466	/-- Transfer of Alice's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   467	dilated strategy to the original one.  For every target family `I` and target
   468	state `ξ`, the distance of Alice's conjugated original variable bits from `I`
   469	is at most three times the distance of the conjugated dilated bits, plus
   470	`216 ε` from the cell-consistency masses of a strategy of value `1 - ε`, plus
   471	`24 η²` where `η` bounds the distance of the transported dilated state from
   472	`ξ`.  The isometry of the original strategy is the composite of the dilation
   473	embedding and `φ_A`, exactly as in the witness of `exists_ms_rigidity`; the
   474	left-hand side is `msOperatorDistanceA S w j W` for that witness, and the
   475	distance on the right is `msOperatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w' j W`.
   476	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   477	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   478	theorem ms_effect_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   479	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   480	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   481	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   482	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (I : ZMod 2 → Op (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   483	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) (j : Fin 9)
   484	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   485	    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   486	        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   487	          (((S.A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
   488	        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
   489	      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)

   800	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   801	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   802	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   803	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA A) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry φA B) 1) ξ‖ ≤
   804	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   805	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   806	            groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B) 1) (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   807	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   808	  have hGc : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   809	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   810	  have hGA := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA) hGc
   811	  have hGB := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hB) hGc
   812	  have hprod : heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   813	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB) *
   814	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   815	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   816	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA A) 1 * heteroKron (conjIsometry φA B) 1 =
   817	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   818	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   819	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1 := by
   820	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul,
   821	      conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   822	  rw [hprod]
   823	  have hT : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   824	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   825	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) (1 : Op κB)) =

   827	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   828	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) 1 - heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (A * B)) 1 := by
   829	    rw [conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   830	  have h1 : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   831	      groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   832	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   833	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A *
   834	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B *
   835	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer))) 1 ≤ 1 :=

   837	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGA hGB))

   839	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (A * B)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   840	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   841	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hA hB))
   842	  have hswap : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   843	      (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   844	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1) ξ =
   845	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   846	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   847	          (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1)
   848	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)) -
   849	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   850	        (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   851	          (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer) - A * B)) 1)
   852	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ) := by
   853	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]

   855	  refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   856	  · rw [applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor]
   857	  · rw [hT]
   858	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le h1 h2 _

   860	/-- The square of a two-term leakage sum is controlled by the cell-mismatch
   861	mass. -/
   862	theorem sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le (ℓ : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (m ε : ℝ)
   863	    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :
   864	    (ℓ 0 + ℓ 1) ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε := by
   865	  have h2 : ∑ b : Fin 2, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := hL
   866	  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h2
   867	  have h3 : ℓ 0 ^ 2 + ℓ 1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m := h2
   868	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ℓ 0 - ℓ 1)]

   870	/-- The final arithmetic of the anticommutator transfer. -/
   871	theorem anticommutator_arith {o a x z η ε : ℝ} (ho : 0 ≤ o)
   872	    (h : o ≤ a + (x + 2 * z + 2 * η) + (z + 2 * x + 2 * η))
   873	    (hx : x ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) (hz : z ^ 2 ≤ 144 * ε) :
   874	    o ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a ^ 2 + 15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   875	  have h1 : o ^ 2 ≤ (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 :=
   876	    pow_le_pow_left₀ ho (by linarith) 2
   877	  have h2 : (a + 3 * (x + z) + 4 * η) ^ 2 ≤
   878	      3 * a ^ 2 + 3 * (3 * (x + z)) ^ 2 + 3 * (4 * η) ^ 2 := by
   879	    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 3 * (x + z)), sq_nonneg (3 * (x + z) - 4 * η),
   880	      sq_nonneg (a - 4 * η)]
   881	  have h3 : (x + z) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 + 2 * z ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - z)]
   882	  nlinarith [h1, h2, h3, hx, hz]

   884	/-- Transfer of Alice's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   885	dilated strategy to the original one.  The left-hand side is
   886	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA S w` for the witness whose isometry is the composite
   887	of the dilation embedding and `φ_A`, and the distance on the right is
   888	`msAnticommutatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w'`.  The transfer costs the
   889	leakage of both dilated observables out of the ground slice, controlled by the
   890	cell-consistency masses, and the state closeness.  Blueprint
   891	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   892	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   893	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   894	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   895	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   896	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   897	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   898	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   899	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   900	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   901	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   902	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   903	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   904	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   905	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   906	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   907	          heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   908	            (obsOf ((S.A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ ≤
   909	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   910	        (fun _ => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   911	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   912	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   913	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)
   914	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   915	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1 *
   916	          heteroKron (conjIsometry φA
   917	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).A (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) 1)) ξ +
   918	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   919	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   920	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   921	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   922	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   923	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_A, naimarkInflation_obs_A]
   924	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   925	      dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   926	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   927	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 -
   928	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   929	        dilatedObsA S (.var 4) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 *
   930	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   931	        dilatedObsA S (.var 0) * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   932	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1 *
   933	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 -
   934	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 *
   935	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   936	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   937	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 0)
   938	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 4)
   939	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   940	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   941	  -- leakage and intertwining of the two observables
   942	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   943	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   944	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   945	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   946	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i0 k0)
   947	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   948	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i4 k4)
   949	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   950	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   951	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   952	  -- product transfers
   953	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   954	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) hXc hZc
   955	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   956	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) hZc hXc
   957	  have hdXZ := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   958	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   959	  have hdZX := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   960	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   961	  -- the anticommutator on the target state
   962	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   963	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   964	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   965	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   966	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   967	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   968	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   969	    congr 1
   970	    abel
   971	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)
   972	    (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1)]
   973	  refine anticommutator_arith (norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqX hsqZ
   974	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   975	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

   111	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le`. -/
   112	theorem norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   113	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   114	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   115	    (A B : Op (ιB × Option α)) (Y : Op (ιA × Option α))
   116	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y ≤ 1) :
   117	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   118	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   119	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   120	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   121	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   122	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   123	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   124	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   125	  have hGG : groundProjection ιB α * groundProjection ιB α = groundProjection ιB α :=
   126	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq
   127	  have hGc : (groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιB α ≤ 1 :=
   128	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α)

   162	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
