   171	        heteroKron Y 1 = heteroKron Y 1 * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) := by

   207	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_product_transfer_le_A`. -/
   208	theorem norm_product_transfer_le_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   209	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   210	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   211	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   212	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (A B : Op (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer))
   213	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hB : Bᴴ * B ≤ 1) :
   214	    ‖applyOperatorToState
   215	        (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   216	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   217	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   218	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   219	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB A) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB B)) ξ‖ ≤
   220	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   221	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   222	            groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)) (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   223	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   224	  have hGc : (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   225	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)
   226	  have hGA := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA) hGc
   227	  have hGB := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hB) hGc
   228	  have hprod : heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   229	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   230	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   231	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   232	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB A) * heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB B) =
   233	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   234	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   235	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)) := by
   236	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, conjIsometry_mul, conjIsometry_mul,
   237	      conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
   238	  rw [hprod]
   239	  have hT : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   240	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   241	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B))) =
   242	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   243	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   244	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))) - heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (A * B)) := by
   245	    rw [conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
   246	  have h1 : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   247	      groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   248	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))))ᴴ *
   249	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A *
   250	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B *
   251	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer))) ≤ 1 :=
   252	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
   253	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGA hGB))
   254	  have h2 : (heteroKron (1 : Op κA) (conjIsometry φB (A * B)))ᴴ *
   255	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (A * B)) ≤ 1 :=
   256	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φB
   257	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hA hB))
   258	  have hswap : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   259	      (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   260	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B))) ξ =
   261	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   262	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   263	          (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)))
   264	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)) -
   265	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   266	        (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * A * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   267	          (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * B * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer) - A * B)))
   268	        (isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ) := by
   269	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   270	  rw [hswap]
   271	  refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   272	  · rw [applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor]
   273	  · rw [hT]
   274	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le h1 h2 _

   276	/-- Transfer of Bob's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   277	dilated strategy to the original one; see `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`.
   278	The left-hand side is `msAnticommutatorDistanceB S w` for the witness whose
   279	isometry is the composite of the dilation embedding and `φ_B`. -/
   280	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   281	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   282	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   283	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   284	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   285	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   286	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   287	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   288	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   289	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   290	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   291	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   292	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   293	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   294	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   295	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ ≤
   296	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   297	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   298	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   299	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   300	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   301	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   302	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   303	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   304	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ +
   305	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   306	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   307	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   308	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ
   309	  rw [opDistSq_uniform_unit, opDistSq_uniform_unit, conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding,
   310	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_B, naimarkInflation_obs_B]
   311	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   312	      dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   313	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   314	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) -
   315	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   316	        dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *
   317	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   318	        dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   319	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)) *
   320	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) -
   321	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) *
   322	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   323	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   324	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero
   325	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero
   326	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   327	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   328	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   329	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i0 k0
   330	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   331	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_B S i4 k4
   332	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i0 k0)
   333	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   334	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_forward S i4 k4)
   335	    (forward_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   336	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   337	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   338	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   339	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) hXc hZc
   340	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   341	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) hZc hXc
   342	  have hdXZ := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   343	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   344	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   345	  have hdZX := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   346	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   347	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   348	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   349	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   350	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   351	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   352	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   353	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   354	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   355	    congr 1
   356	    abel
   357	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))
   358	    (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)))]
   359	  refine anticommutator_arith (norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqX hsqZ
   360	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   361	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

    71	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    72	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d]
    73	    (M : Measurement (α × β) d) : Measurement β d :=
    74	  M.postprocess Prod.snd

    76	/-- Projectivity of every effect in a POVM (`def:povm-conventions`, blueprint
    77	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:8-26`; paper origin

    83	/--
    84	The tensor-product strategy of `def:tensor-product-strategy` in
    85	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69` (paper origin
    86	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`).
    87	-/
    88	structure Strategy (G : Game) where
    89	  ιA : Type
    90	  ιB : Type
    91	  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
    92	  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
    93	  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
    94	  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
    95	  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
    96	  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
    97	  A : G.QuestionA → Measurement G.AnswerA ιA
    98	  B : G.QuestionB → Measurement G.AnswerB ιB
    99	
   100	attribute [instance] Strategy.ιAFintype Strategy.ιBFintype
   101	  Strategy.ιADecidableEq Strategy.ιBDecidableEq
   102	
   103	/-- The rectangular tensor placement used in strategy probabilities.  This is
   104	the finite-matrix realization of `def:tensor-product-strategy`, blueprint
   105	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`; paper origin
   106	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`.
   107	-/
   108	def heteroKron {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) : Op (ιA × ιB) :=
   109	  Matrix.kronecker A B
   110	
   111	/-! ### Algebra of the tensor placement
   112	
   113	The shared tensor-placement API.  These identities are used both by the perfect
   114	Magic Square strategy (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint
   115	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:257-267`) and by the rigidity transfer
   116	step (`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`), so they live
   117	with the definition rather than in either development. -/
   118	
   119	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   120	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`, paper
   121	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`): the tensor
   122	placement is multiplicative, `(A ⊗ C) * (B ⊗ D) = (A * B) ⊗ (C * D)`. -/
   123	theorem heteroKron_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   124	    (A B : Op ιA) (C D : Op ιB) :
   125	    heteroKron A C * heteroKron B D = heteroKron (A * B) (C * D) := by
   126	  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
   127	  exact (Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul A B C D).symm
   128	
   129	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   130	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): the tensor
   131	placement of the two identity operators is the identity operator on the product
   132	space. -/
   133	theorem heteroKron_one_one {ιA ιB : Type*} [DecidableEq ιA] [DecidableEq ιB] :
   134	    heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (1 : Op ιB) = 1 := by
   135	  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
   136	  exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
   137	
   138	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   139	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
   140	respects negation in the left factor. -/
   141	theorem heteroKron_neg_left {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
   142	    heteroKron (-A) C = -heteroKron A C := by
   143	  ext p q
   144	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
   145	
   146	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
   147	(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): tensor placement
   148	respects negation in the right factor. -/
   149	theorem heteroKron_neg_right {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
   150	    heteroKron A (-C) = -heteroKron A C := by
   151	  ext p q
   152	  simp [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker]
   153	
   154	/- The Euclidean linear map is the shared action used by the value and distance
   155	functionals.  Keeping it at the Euclidean-space level avoids accidentally
   156	using the function-space supremum norm of `Matrix.mulVec`. -/
   157	/-- Apply a finite matrix to a Euclidean-space state.  This is the Hilbert-space
   158	action underlying `def:tensor-product-value`, paper
   159	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-271`. -/
   160	noncomputable def applyOperatorToState {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   161	    (M : Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι :=
   162	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin M ψ
   163	
   164	/-- The Born weight of an answer pair for a strategy.  Lean-only support for
   165	`def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper
   166	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/
   167	noncomputable def outcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   168	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   169	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   170	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)
   171	  let acted := applyOperatorToState M S.ψ
   172	  (inner ℂ S.ψ acted).re
   173	
   174	/-- Alice's marginal Born weight for an answer at a fixed question. -/
   175	noncomputable def aliceOutcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   176	    (x : G.QuestionA) (a : G.AnswerA) : ℝ :=
   177	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   178	    heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1
   179	  (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re
   180	
   181	/-- Bob's marginal Born weight for an answer at a fixed question. -/
   182	noncomputable def bobOutcomeWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   183	    (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   184	  let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
   185	    heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b)
   186	  (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re
   187	
   188	/-- The Born weight of a decidable event on the two answers at fixed questions. -/
   189	noncomputable def outcomeEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   190	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   191	    (E : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] : ℝ :=
   192	  ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   193	    if E a b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
   194	
   195	/-- The marginal Born weight of a decidable event on Alice's answer. -/
   196	noncomputable def aliceEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   197	    (x : G.QuestionA) (E : G.AnswerA → Prop) [DecidablePred E] : ℝ :=
   198	  ∑ a : G.AnswerA, if E a then aliceOutcomeWeight S x a else 0
   199	
   200	/-- The marginal Born weight of a decidable event on Bob's answer. -/
   201	noncomputable def bobEventWeight {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   202	    (y : G.QuestionB) (E : G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidablePred E] : ℝ :=
   203	  ∑ b : G.AnswerB, if E b then bobOutcomeWeight S y b else 0
   204	
   205	/-- Every answer-pair Born weight is nonnegative.  This is formalization-only
   206	support for the probability expression in `def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   207	theorem outcomeWeight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   208	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   209	    0 ≤ outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
   210	  unfold outcomeWeight applyOperatorToState heteroKron
   211	  exact
   212	    (Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr
   213	      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
   214	        (kronecker_nonneg ((S.A x).pos a) ((S.B y).pos b)))).re_inner_nonneg_right S.ψ
   215	
   216	/-- The Born weights of all answer pairs at fixed questions sum to one.  This
   217	is formalization-only support for the POVM normalization implicit in
   218	`def:tensor-product-value`. -/
   219	theorem outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   220	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) :
   221	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 := by
   222	  have hsum :
   223	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   224	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   225	          (1 : Op (S.ιA × S.ιB)) := by
   226	    ext i j
   227	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   228	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   229	    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
   230	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   231	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   232	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   233	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   234	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   235	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   236	    exact congrFun (congrFun
   237	      (Matrix.one_kronecker_one (m := S.ιA) (n := S.ιB) (α := ℂ)) i) j
   238	  calc
   239	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b =
   240	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   241	          (applyOperatorToState
   242	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   243	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   244	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   245	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState 1 S.ψ)).re := by rw [hsum]
   246	    _ = 1 := by
   247	      simp [applyOperatorToState, S.ψ_norm]
   248	
   249	/-- Summing over Bob's answers gives Alice's marginal Born weight. -/
   250	theorem sum_outcome_weight_right {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   251	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) :
   252	    (∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = aliceOutcomeWeight S x a := by
   253	  have hsum :
   254	      (∑ b : G.AnswerB, heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   255	        heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1 := by
   256	    ext i j
   257	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   258	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   259	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
   260	    rw [show (∑ b : G.AnswerB, (S.B y).effect b i.2 j.2) =
   261	        (1 : Op S.ιB) i.2 j.2 by
   262	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.B y).sum_eq_one i.2) j.2]
   263	  calc
   264	    (∑ b : G.AnswerB, outcomeWeight S x y a b) =
   265	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   266	          (applyOperatorToState
   267	            (∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   268	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   269	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   270	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ
   271	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1) S.ψ)).re := by
   272	      rw [hsum]
   273	    _ = aliceOutcomeWeight S x a := rfl
   274	
   275	/-- Summing over Alice's answers gives Bob's marginal Born weight. -/
   276	theorem sum_outcome_weight_left {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   277	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) :
   278	    (∑ a : G.AnswerA, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = bobOutcomeWeight S y b := by
   279	  have hsum :
   280	      (∑ a : G.AnswerA, heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) =
   281	        heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b) := by
   282	    ext i j
   283	    simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
   284	      Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
   285	    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
   286	    rw [show (∑ a : G.AnswerA, (S.A x).effect a i.1 j.1) =
   287	        (1 : Op S.ιA) i.1 j.1 by
   288	      simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using congrFun (congrFun (S.A x).sum_eq_one i.1) j.1]
   289	  calc
   290	    (∑ a : G.AnswerA, outcomeWeight S x y a b) =
   291	        (inner ℂ S.ψ
   292	          (applyOperatorToState
   293	            (∑ a : G.AnswerA,
   294	              heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   295	          simp [outcomeWeight, applyOperatorToState]
   296	    _ = (inner ℂ S.ψ
   297	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re := by
   298	      rw [hsum]
   299	    _ = bobOutcomeWeight S y b := rfl
   300	
   301	/-- Every answer event has nonnegative Born weight. -/
   302	theorem outcome_event_weight_nonneg {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   303	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   304	    (E : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] :
   305	    0 ≤ outcomeEventWeight S x y E := by
   306	  unfold outcomeEventWeight
   307	  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => by
   308	    split_ifs
   309	    · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
   310	    · exact le_rfl
   311	
   312	/-- An answer event depending only on Alice has its Alice marginal weight. -/
   313	theorem outcome_event_weight_left_eq {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   314	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   315	    (E : G.AnswerA → Prop) [DecidablePred E] :
   316	    outcomeEventWeight S x y (fun a _ => E a) = aliceEventWeight S x E := by
   317	  unfold outcomeEventWeight aliceEventWeight
   318	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   319	  intro a _
   320	  by_cases ha : E a
   321	  · simp [ha, sum_outcome_weight_right S x y a]
   322	  · simp [ha]
   323	
   324	/-- An answer event depending only on Bob has its Bob marginal weight. -/
   325	theorem outcome_event_weight_right_eq {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   326	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   327	    (E : G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidablePred E] :
   328	    outcomeEventWeight S x y (fun _ b => E b) = bobEventWeight S y E := by
   329	  unfold outcomeEventWeight bobEventWeight
   330	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   331	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   332	  intro b _
   333	  by_cases hb : E b
   334	  · simp [hb, sum_outcome_weight_left S x y b]
   335	  · simp [hb]
   336	
   337	/-- Inclusion of answer events implies the corresponding Born-weight inequality. -/
   338	theorem outcome_event_weight_mono {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   339	    (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)
   340	    (E F : G.AnswerA → G.AnswerB → Prop) [DecidableRel E] [DecidableRel F]
   341	    (hEF : ∀ a b, E a b → F a b) :
   342	    outcomeEventWeight S x y E ≤ outcomeEventWeight S x y F := by
   343	  unfold outcomeEventWeight
   344	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   345	  intro a _
   346	  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   347	  intro b _
   348	  by_cases hE : E a b
   349	  · simp [hE, hEF a b hE]
   350	  · simp only [hE, ↓reduceIte]
   351	    split_ifs
   352	    · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
   353	    · exact le_rfl
   354	
   355	/--
   356	The tensor-product value, expressed as the distribution average of the Born
   357	probabilities.  This is `def:tensor-product-value` in
   358	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, with paper origin
   359	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`.
   360	-/
   361	noncomputable def Strategy.value {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) : ℝ :=
   362	  avgOver G.μ (fun xy =>
   363	    ∑ a : G.AnswerA, ∑ b : G.AnswerB,
   364	      if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then outcomeWeight S xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0)
   365	
   366	/--
   367	The tensor-product game value as a conditional supremum over all finite
   368	strategies.  The `sSup (Set.range ...)` form is the csSup formulation requested
   369	for `def:tensor-product-value`, blueprint
   370	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:71-82`, paper origin
   371	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-57`; attainment is
   372	intentionally not asserted here.
   373	-/
   374	noncomputable def Game.value (G : Game) : ℝ :=
   375	  sSup (Set.range (fun S : Strategy G => S.value))
   376

   431	/-! ## The ground projection -/
   432	
   433	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   434	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   435	transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   436	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   437	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   438	  naimarkInflation (α := α) (1 : Op ι)
   439	
   440	/-- Inflation is multiplicative. -/
   441	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   442	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   443	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   444	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   445	  ext p q
   446	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   447	    Fintype.sum_option]
   448	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   449	
   450	/-- Inflation commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   451	theorem naimarkInflation_conjTranspose {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   452	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   453	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by
   454	  ext p q
   455	  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, naimarkInflation_apply]
   456	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   457	
   458	/-- The ground projection is an orthogonal projection. -/
   459	theorem isProj_groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   460	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : IsProj (groundProjection ι α) := by
   461	  constructor
   462	  · change groundProjection ι α * groundProjection ι α = groundProjection ι α
   463	    rw [groundProjection, naimarkInflation_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   464	  · change star (groundProjection ι α) = groundProjection ι α
   465	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, groundProjection, naimarkInflation_conjTranspose,
   466	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one]
   467	
   468	/-- Inflating the compression of an operator to the ground slice is compressing
   469	it by the ground projection. -/
   470	theorem naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   471	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (P : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   472	    naimarkInflation (α := α) (naimarkCompression (α := α) P) =
   473	      groundProjection ι α * P * groundProjection ι α := by
   474	  ext p q
   475	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, naimarkCompression_apply,
   476	    groundProjection, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, Matrix.one_apply]
   477	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   478	
   479	/-- Compression to the ground slice commutes with finite sums. -/
   480	theorem naimarkCompression_finset_sum {ι α β : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   481	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset β) (M : β → Op (ι × Option α)) :
   482	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (∑ b ∈ s, M b) =
   483	      ∑ b ∈ s, naimarkCompression (α := α) (M b) := by
   484	  ext i j
   485	  simp [Matrix.sum_apply]
   486	
   487	/-- The dilated state lies in the ground slice on Alice's side. -/
   488	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   489	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   490	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   491	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   492	      naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   493	  have hfull : applyOperatorToState
   494	      (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιB α))
   495	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   496	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   497	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   498	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]
   499	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   500	    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   501	  exact hfull
   502	
   503	/-- The dilated state lies in the ground slice on Bob's side. -/
   504	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   505	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   506	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   507	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α)) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   508	      naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   509	  have hfull : applyOperatorToState
   510	      (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιB α))
   511	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = naimarkDilatedState α ψ := by
   512	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   513	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]
   514	  conv_lhs => rw [← hfull]
   515	  rw [← applyOperatorToState_mul, heteroKron_mul,
   516	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   517	  exact hfull

   519	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Alice's
   520	side. -/
   521	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   522	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   523	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   524	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   525	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   526	  have h : heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   527	      1 - heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1 := by
   528	    rw [heteroKron_sub_left, heteroKron_one_one]
   529	  have hsub : applyOperatorToState (1 - heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   530	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   531	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   532	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   533	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   534	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   535	  rw [h, hsub, applyOperatorToState_one, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection,

   540	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   541	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   542	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   550	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   551	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α))
   552	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by

   557	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   558	
   559	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   560	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   561	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   562	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   563	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
   564	theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   565	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   566	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   567	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   568	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   569	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   570	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   571	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   572	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   573	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   574	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   575	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   576	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   577	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   578	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   579	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
   580	  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
   581	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   582	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   583	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   584	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   585	      Matrix.mul_one]
   586	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
   587	      applyOperatorToState L
   588	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
   589	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   590	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
   591	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
   592	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
   593	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   594	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
   595	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   596	  rw [key]
   597	  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   598	
   599	/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
   600	dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
   601	operator. -/
   602	theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   603	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   604	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   605	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   606	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   607	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   608	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   609	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   610	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   611	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   612	    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
   613	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   614	    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   615	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   616	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
   617	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
   618	  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   619	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
   620	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   621	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
   622	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   623	      Matrix.mul_one]
   624	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
   625	      applyOperatorToState L
   626	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
   627	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   628	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   629	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
   630	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   631	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   632	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
   633	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   634	  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   635	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   636	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   637	  rw [key]
   638	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L
   639	          (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ')‖ ≤
   640	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ'‖ :=
   641	        norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   642	    _ = ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ'‖ := by
   643	        rw [← hneg, norm_neg]
   644

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/
    43

    55	/-- The Born overlap of Alice's totalized variable bit with Bob's totalized
    56	constraint bit, summed over the bit, is the complement of the reverse
    57	cell-mismatch mass. -/
    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    65	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    66	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    67	      ∑ a : msGame.AnswerA, ∑ c : msGame.AnswerB,
    68	        if msBitOrZero a = b then
    69	          (if constraintBitOrZero k c = b then
    70	            outcomeWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a c else 0)
    71	        else 0 := by
    72	    intro b
    73	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    74	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    75	      heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    76	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    77	    split_ifs
    78	    · rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    79	      rfl
    80	    · simp
    81	  have htotal := outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
    82	  unfold reverseCellMismatchMass outcomeEventWeight
    83	  simp_rw [hterm]
    84	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← htotal, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    85	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    86	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    87	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    88	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    89	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    90	  by_cases h : msBitOrZero a = constraintBitOrZero k c
    91	  · simp [h]
    92	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

   152	theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   289	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
   290	      applyOperatorToState_zero]
   291	  rw [hzero, add_zero]

   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   346	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
   347	  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   348	      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   349	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   350	        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   351	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   352	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
   353	  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   354	    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
   355	  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
   356	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   357	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
   358	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
   359	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   360	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
   361	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   362	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   363	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   365	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   366	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   367	    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
   368	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
   369	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
   370	      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   371	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   372	      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
   373	    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   374	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
   375	    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
   376	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
   377	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   378	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
   379	        norm_sub_le _ _
   380	    _ ≤ _ := by
   381	        rw [h2]
   382	        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
   383	          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]

   394	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) - T) ξ‖ +

   396	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))

   398	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by

   400	  have hQ := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectB S y g b

   411	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hQ) hG))
   412	  set Bo : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   413	    dilatedEffectB S y g b * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) with hBo_def
   414	  set Bd : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b)) with hBd_def
   415	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   416	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ =
   417	      applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ := by
   418	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   419	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ =
   420	      applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   421	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   422	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ψ''‖ ≤
   423	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   424	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   425	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   426	    have hdiff : Bd - Bo = heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedEffectB S y g b -
   427	        groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer * dilatedEffectB S y g b *
   428	          groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) := by
   429	      rw [hBd_def, hBo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_right]
   430	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   431	      applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression]
   432	    exact norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   433	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=

   435	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Bo - T) ξ‖ =
   436	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   437	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Bd - Bo) ξ‖ :=

   444	/-- Squaring a three-term estimate. -/
   445	theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :
   446	    w ^ 2 ≤ 3 * x ^ 2 + 3 * y ^ 2 + 3 * z ^ 2 := by
   447	  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2
   448	  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - y), sq_nonneg (y - z), sq_nonneg (x - z)]

   450	/-- Summing the per-outcome estimates over the two outcomes. -/
   451	theorem sum_sq_le_of_le (d ℓ o : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (η ε m : ℝ)

   456	    fun b => sq_le_three_mul_of_le (ho b) (h b)
   457	  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
   458	        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
   459	    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by
   460	        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
   461	          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
   462	        push_cast
   463	        ring
   464	    _ ≤ 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 216 * ε + 24 * η ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hL, hm]

   503	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))

   507	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)

   687	/-- The defect of the compressed product `Π A Π · Π B Π` against `A B` on the
   688	dilated state is controlled by the leakage of `A` and `B` and the intertwining
   689	defect of `B` against any right-placed contraction `Y`.  Since `Π ψ' = ψ'`,
   690	`(Π A Π Π B Π - A B) ψ' = -(Π A (1 - Π) B) ψ' - ((1 - Π) A B) ψ'`; the first
   691	term is bounded by the leakage of `B`, and in the second `B ψ'` is replaced by
   692	`Y ψ'`, which commutes past `(1 - Π) A`. -/
   693	theorem norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   694	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   695	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   696	    (A B : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Y : Op (ιB × Option α))
   697	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y ≤ 1) :
   698	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α *
   699	        (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α) - A * B) 1)
   700	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   701	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B) 1)
   702	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   703	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) 1)
   704	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   705	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron B 1 - heteroKron 1 Y) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   706	  have hGG : groundProjection ιA α * groundProjection ιA α = groundProjection ιA α :=
   707	    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq
   708	  have hGc : (groundProjection ιA α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιA α ≤ 1 :=
   709	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α)
   710	  have h1Gc : (1 - groundProjection ιA α)ᴴ * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) ≤ 1 :=
   711	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub
   712	  have hstep1 : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A *
   713	      groundProjection ιA α * (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   714	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   715	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B) 1)
   716	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   717	    have hassoc : groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α *
   718	        (groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α) =
   719	        groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B * groundProjection ιA α := by
   720	      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   721	      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (groundProjection ιA α) (groundProjection ιA α) (B * _), hGG]
   722	    rw [hassoc, show heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B *
   723	        groundProjection ιA α) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   724	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B) 1 *
   725	          heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1 by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one],
   726	      applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection]
   727	  have hdec : groundProjection ιA α * A * groundProjection ιA α * B - A * B =
   728	      -(groundProjection ιA α * A * ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B)) -
   729	        ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) * B := by
   730	    noncomm_ring
   731	  have hfirst : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A *
   732	      ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B)) 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   733	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B) 1)
   734	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   735	    rw [show heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A * ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B))
   736	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   737	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * A) 1 * heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * B) 1
   738	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   739	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   740	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA)) _
   741	  have hsecond : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) * B) 1)

   743	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron B 1 - heteroKron 1 Y) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   744	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) 1)
   745	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   746	    have hL : (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)))ᴴ *

   755	    rw [show heteroKron (((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) * B) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   756	        heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * A) 1 * heteroKron B 1

   111	/-- Right-placed counterpart of `norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le`. -/
   112	theorem norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   113	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   114	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   115	    (A B : Op (ιB × Option α)) (Y : Op (ιA × Option α))
   116	    (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) (hY : Yᴴ * Y ≤ 1) :
   117	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   118	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   119	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   120	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   121	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   122	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   123	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   124	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   125	  have hGG : groundProjection ιB α * groundProjection ιB α = groundProjection ιB α :=
   126	    (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).isIdempotentElem.eq
   127	  have hGc : (groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * groundProjection ιB α ≤ 1 :=
   128	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α)
   129	  have h1Gc : (1 - groundProjection ιB α)ᴴ * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) ≤ 1 :=
   130	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub
   131	  have hstep1 : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   132	      groundProjection ιB α * (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α)))
   133	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   134	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B))
   135	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   136	    have hassoc : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   137	        (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   138	        groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α := by
   139	      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
   140	      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (groundProjection ιB α) (groundProjection ιB α) (B * _), hGG]
   141	    rw [hassoc, show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   142	        groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) =
   143	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B) *
   144	          heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α) by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one],
   145	      applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection]
   146	  have hdec : groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α * B - A * B =
   147	      -(groundProjection ιB α * A * ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) -
   148	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B := by
   149	    noncomm_ring
   150	  have hfirst : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   151	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   152	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))
   153	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   154	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   155	        ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)) =
   156	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A) * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B)
   157	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   158	    exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   159	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hGc hA)) _
   160	  have hsecond : ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   161	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   162	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1 - heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   163	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))
   164	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   165	    have hL : (heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A))ᴴ *
   166	        heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) ≤ 1 :=
   167	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul h1Gc hA)
   168	    have hYc : (heteroKron Y (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)))ᴴ * heteroKron Y 1 ≤ 1 :=
   169	      conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor hY
   170	    have hcomm : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) *
   171	        heteroKron Y 1 = heteroKron Y 1 * heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) := by
   172	      rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   173	        Matrix.mul_one]
   174	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α)) (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B) =
   175	        heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * heteroKron 1 B
   176	        by rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one], applyOperatorToState_mul]
   177	    have hdecB : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 B) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   178	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 B - heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) +
   179	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron Y 1) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   180	      rw [applyOperatorToState_sub_op, sub_add_cancel]
   181	    rw [hdecB, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul _ (heteroKron Y 1), hcomm,
   182	      applyOperatorToState_mul, norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_comm (heteroKron Y 1)]
   183	    refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
   184	    · exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hL _
   185	    · exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hYc _
   186	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   187	          (groundProjection ιB α * B * groundProjection ιB α) - A * B))
   188	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ =
   189	        ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A * groundProjection ιB α *
   190	          B - A * B)) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   191	        rw [heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_sub_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   192	          applyOperatorToState_sub_op, hstep1]
   193	    _ = ‖-applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   194	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   195	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   196	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   197	        rw [hdec, heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_neg_right, applyOperatorToState_sub_op,
   198	          applyOperatorToState_neg_op]
   199	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * A *
   200	          ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * B))) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ +
   201	          ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * A) * B))
   202	            (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   203	        refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) ?_
   204	        rw [norm_neg]
   205	    _ ≤ _ := by linarith [hfirst, hsecond]

   276	/-- Transfer of Bob's anticommutator estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the

   280	theorem ms_anticommutator_transfer_B {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]

   282	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)

   284	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (ε η : ℝ)
   285	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value)
   286	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :
   287	    opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   288	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   289	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   290	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   291	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   292	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   293	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   294	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry (φB.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιB MsAnswer))
   295	            (obsOf ((S.B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ ≤
   296	      3 * opDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   297	        (fun _ => heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   298	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   299	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   300	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))
   301	        (fun _ => -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   302	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 4)).postprocess msBitOrZero))) *
   303	          heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB
   304	            (obsOf (((msDilatedStrategy S).B (.var 0)).postprocess msBitOrZero))))) ξ +
   305	      15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2 := by
   306	  obtain ⟨i0, k0, h0⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 0
   307	  obtain ⟨i4, k4, h4⟩ := every_variable_is_incident 4
   308	  have hξ' : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ ≤ η := hξ

   310	    conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_obs_B, naimarkInflation_obs_B]
   311	  change ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer *
   312	      dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero * groundProjection S.ιB MsAnswer)) *

   320	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) -
   321	      -(heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)) *
   322	      heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))) ξ‖ ^ 2 +

   324	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero
   325	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero
   326	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   327	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)

   336	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   337	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ
   338	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   339	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) hXc hZc
   340	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_B S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   341	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) hZc hXc
   342	  have hdXZ := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   343	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)
   344	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   345	  have hdZX := norm_rightTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ
   346	    (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero) (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)
   347	    (dilatedObsAf S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc

   351	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   352	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by

   354	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   355	    congr 1
   356	    abel
   357	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 0) msBitOrZero)))
   358	    (heteroKron 1 (conjIsometry φB (dilatedObsB S (.var 4) msBitOrZero)))]

+/-! ### Algebra of the tensor placement
+
+The shared tensor-placement API.  These identities are used both by the perfect
+Magic Square strategy (`thm:ms-from-ac`, blueprint
+`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:257-267`) and by the rigidity transfer
+step (`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`), so they live
+with the definition rather than in either development. -/
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`, paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:26-38`): the tensor
+placement is multiplicative, `(A ⊗ C) * (B ⊗ D) = (A * B) ⊗ (C * D)`. -/
+theorem heteroKron_mul {ιA ιB : Type*} [Fintype ιA] [Fintype ιB]
+    (A B : Op ιA) (C D : Op ιB) :
+    heteroKron A C * heteroKron B D = heteroKron (A * B) (C * D) := by
+  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
+  exact (Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul A B C D).symm
+
+/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for `def:tensor-product-strategy`
+(blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:61-69`): the tensor
+placement of the two identity operators is the identity operator on the product
+space. -/

+    heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (1 : Op ιB) = 1 := by
+  unfold heteroKron Matrix.kronecker

+respects negation in the left factor. -/
+theorem heteroKron_neg_left {ιA ιB : Type*} (A : Op ιA) (C : Op ιB) :
+    heteroKron (-A) C = -heteroKron A C := by

 `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:40-48`. -/

     (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB) (a : G.AnswerA) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
     heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)

   let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
     heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1
   (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re

     (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) : ℝ :=
   let M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
     heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b)
   (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState M S.ψ)).re

     (x : G.QuestionA) (y : G.QuestionB)

 /-- The ideal two-qubit projector for one Magic Square output bit. The other

 noncomputable def idealMagicBitProj (W : PauliKind) (b : ZMod 2) :
     Op (Fin 2 → ZMod 2) :=
   ∑ e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2, if e 0 = b then pauliProj W e else 0
 
 /-- The ideal state in `thm:ms-rigidity`: two EPR pairs followed by the

     [Fintype ιA''] [DecidableEq ιA''] [Fintype ιB''] [DecidableEq ιB'']
     (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA'' × ιB'')) :
     EuclideanSpace ℂ
       (((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ιA'') × ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ιB'')) :=
   reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor (eprState (Fin 2 → ZMod 2)) aux)

1	import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.SubMeasurementCore
     2	import MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement

     4	/-!
     5	# Section 5 — Making measurements projective: definitions
     6	
     7	Definitions for Naimark dilation and orthonormalization, matching
     8	Section 5 of `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex` and
     9	Chapter 4 of the blueprint (`blueprint/src/chapter/ch04_projective.tex`).
    10	
    11	## Naimark dilation structure
    12	
    13	The key mathematical content is the **Naimark dilation theorem**: given
    14	submeasurements on a bipartite space, there exist auxiliary registers and
    15	projective measurements on the enlarged space that preserve all correlations
    16	exactly.
    17	
    18	### One-measurement Naimark (Lemma 5.2)
    19	
    20	The building block is the one-measurement Naimark lemma. Given a
    21	submeasurement `{M_a}_{a ∈ α}` on `Op d`, it produces a projective
    22	submeasurement on the enlarged space `Op (d × Option α)`. The auxiliary
    23	register has dimension `|α| + 1`, with the extra dimension absorbing the
    24	"missing mass" `I − ∑ M_a`. The construction uses the isometry
    25	`V|ψ⟩ = ∑_a √M_a |ψ⟩ ⊗ |a⟩ + √(I−M)|ψ⟩ ⊗ |⊥⟩` and defines
    26	`P̂_a = V† (I ⊗ |a⟩⟨a|) V`.
    27	
    28	### Questionwise Naimark data
    29	
    30	For a prospective full bipartite assembly, one-measurement Naimark is applied
    31	independently to each question on each side.  The current formal interface
    32	records these questionwise local data and their marginal preservation
    33	identities, not the full tensor-product correlation theorem.
    34	
    35	## Matrix-level witnesses
    36	
    37	Concrete `Matrix d d ℂ` witnesses are provided alongside the abstract
    38	operator-algebra formulation, giving honest probability and overlap formulas.
    39	-/
    40	
    41	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    42	
    43	namespace MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective
    44	
    45	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    46	
    47	/-! ### Finite Hilbert space infrastructure -/

    57	attribute [instance] FiniteHilbertSpace.instDecidableEq

    59

    62	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op H.carrier
    63	
    64	namespace MatrixOperator

    67	instances record that choice once for the project's concrete operator type,

    97	/-- A positive operator used as a possibly unnormalized state witness. -/
    98	structure PositiveMatrixState (H : FiniteHilbertSpace) where

   100	  positive : 0 ≤ matrix

   102	/-- Concrete submeasurements on a finite Hilbert space. -/
